title: Customer Support Coach – Integrations
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

How You'll Make an Impact:

As our Customer Support Coach – Integrations in Thailand, you’ll be the deepest expert at Cloudbeds on our MecX Tech integrations, principally the Carmen Accounting interface and the TM30 Immigration reporting integration. You’ll be the person Thai customers, support agents, and partners turn to when something isn’t flowing. Thai hoteliers must report every foreign guest to Immigration within 24 hours under TM30, and every night’s revenue has to land cleanly in a finance system built for Thai accounting standards. When those handoffs break, front desk teams become data-entry clerks and properties carry real regulatory risk.

This is a coaching role as much as a technical one. You’ll resolve the hardest escalations yourself, then turn each one into playbooks, articles, and hands-on training that raise the floor for the whole support org, and you’ll use AI and automation to cut repetitive diagnostic work so your time goes to the hoteliers who need it. If you get satisfaction from finding the root cause, fixing it for good, and teaching others to spot it, we’d love to hear from you.

Our Customer Support Team:

We are a fully remote group of former hoteliers, technologists, and customer experience professionals focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can spend more time solving the problem behind the problem and helping customers feel confident and supported. If you’re driven by curiosity and ownership and prefer deeply personalized hospitality moments over repetitive operational tasks, you’ll feel right at home here.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and primary escalation point for MecX Tech integrations, with end-to-end ownership of the Carmen Accounting interface and the TM30 Immigration reporting integration. Investigate complex failures using logs, API tooling, and structured troubleshooting until you reach the root cause, not just a workaround.
  • Make sure Thai properties meet their TM30 obligations reliably through Cloudbeds by tracking submission success rates and driving down failures before they become regulatory exposure. Partner with Onboarding and Sales so new properties are configured correctly on Carmen and TM30 from day one.
  • Mentor and upskill Support agents across the region on Thai integrations through training sessions, decision trees, troubleshooting guides, and ticket shadow reviews, so the team resolves more without escalating. Drive adoption of AI and modern tooling to cut diagnostic drag.
  • Act as the day-to-day technical liaison with development and integration partners: triage jointly, escalate cleanly, keep a shared issue log, and keep resolution moving on both sides.
  • Translate recurring field issues into clear, well-evidenced bug reports and product feedback, advocate for the Thai market internally, and track fixes through to release.
  • Own the knowledge base, capturing what you learn in searchable, reusable documentation in both Thai and English so the next person doesn’t have to solve it again.
  • Track and report integration health metrics (ticket volume, time to resolution, escalation rate, integration error rates, and more), and use them to target where coaching and product fixes will have the most impact.

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 3+ years in a technical support, integrations support, or implementation role, able to read API documentation, interpret JSON/XML payloads, work through logs, and use tools like Postman to isolate where a data flow breaks
  • Experience in hotel operations or hospitality technology (PMS, channel manager, POS, or hotel back-office/accounting systems), familiar with night audit, revenue posting, and how a hotel closes its day
  • Native or business-fluent Thai plus strong professional English: you can troubleshoot with a hotel GM in Bangkok in the morning and write a crisp escalation to a US engineering team in the afternoon, explaining technical and business concepts clearly in both languages, in writing and in conversation
  • Proven ability to teach, mentor, and level up peers: you document as you go and get satisfaction from making yourself unnecessary on the next ticket
  • High emotional intelligence and calm ownership when a customer is blocked, frustrated, or facing a deadline
  • Accountable, data-driven, and detail-oriented, with experience in modern tools like Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce or similar, and comfortable working with AI and picking up new software quickly
  • Comfortable working alongside people from diverse cultures and backgrounds across many time zones

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

  • Direct experience with Carmen Software or another hotel back-office/accounting platform (Sun Systems, Xero, QuickBooks, SAP), or hands-on experience with TM30 / Thai Immigration reporting or other government compliance reporting integrations
  • Prior experience working with or at a Thai hospitality technology partner or reseller, or a hospitality degree or hotel operations background
  • Basic scripting or query ability (SQL, Python) for investigating data issues at scale, and additional regional languages (Mandarin, Japanese, Bahasa) for broader APAC coverage

Work Authorization: Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.

You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work.

Key Responsibilities

AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

  • Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.
  • Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.
  • Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.
  • Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.
  • Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.

DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

  • Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
  • Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
  • Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
  • Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).
  • 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
  • Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
  • Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
  • DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).

title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

title: AI Applied Scientist
description:
About the Science and AI Team

The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair.

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

 

About the Role

The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on.

1. Client projects

  • Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs.

  • Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention.

  • Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence.

  • Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on.

  • Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live.

2. Testing scoring quality

  • Compare AI scores with expert ratings to check accuracy and reliability before anything goes live.

  • Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

3. Fairness in practice

  • Run bias checks across demographic groups for each client project.

  • Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

  • Support fairness reports and compliance documentation for clients.

4. Improving our scoring systems

  • Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost.

  • Support the move onto self-hosted open-weight models, including fine-tuning on expert-rated data.

  • Work with engineering to roll out scoring changes safely.

As one of Maki People’s early employees, you’ll help shape the team’s future.


Our Ideal Candidate

Required

  • MSc or PhD in data science, machine learning, psychology or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based scoring or evaluation.

  • Strong Python or R skills, with solid statistical analysis.

  • Experience presenting data-driven findings to clients or senior business stakeholders.

  • Able to manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines.

Preferred

  • Experience in consulting, people analytics or assessment.

  • Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT.

  • Experience testing AI systems for fairness and bias.

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

  • Working knowledge of ethical AI and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

     

Application Process

  • Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min)

  • Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min)

  • Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

  • Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min)

  • Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min)

  • Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

description:

A fast-growing AI data company is hiring supply chain practitioners to design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks for evaluating AI agents. You will turn real planning work into end-to-end challenges, each with files, a working solution and an automated correctness check. The goal is to build a benchmark grounded in real operations work.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning a real supply chain task from your work into a challenge an AI agent solves end to end.

â¢ Define the files, data exports and systems each task runs on, such as ERP, MES and WMS extracts, so the scenario reflects realistic planning conditions.

â¢ Write a working solution for each task, for example a 5-day production plan, and confirm it can be solved in 60 to 75 minutes.

â¢ Build the automated check that proves the result is correct, using tests or scripts that accept valid answers and catch planning errors objectively.

â¢ Document the written rules, constraints and SOPs that decide each case, along with realistic edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors from your process.

â¢ Technical fluency in Python or another language and the command line, plus files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

â¢ Available to start around November 4, 2026

Nice-to-have

â¢ Automated or audited the process with scripts, SQL, RPA or rules engines

â¢ 5+ years in the same process family

â¢ Docker, Git and experience writing tests

â¢ Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERPs and TMS/WMS platforms

Process

â¢ Task-based engagement paid per task, with each task taking about 60 to 75 minutes

title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
description:
De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen.

 

Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector.

 

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.

 

Dit ga je doen:

  • Samenwerken met toezichthouders om risico’s voor consumenten tijdig te signaleren.

  • Ontwikkelen van dataproducten die inzichten vertalen naar gerichte acties.

  • Implementeren van betrouwbare en schaalbare oplossingen voor effectiever toezicht.

  • Visualiseren van resultaten in dashboards die toezichthouders ondersteunen.

  • Kansen signaleren om processen slimmer in te richten en repetitief werk te automatiseren.

  • Experimenteren met nieuwe technieken zoals AI om toezicht slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

 

Team
Team Data Analyse & Innovatie is één van de vijf teams binnen de afdeling LSR. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de Datagedreven Toezicht Strategie (DGT) van LSR.

 

Dit betekent dat het team toezichtsvragen vertaalt naar oplossingen met data. We bouwen aan een stevige basis en een duidelijke planning (roadmap) voor de hele afdeling. Ook helpt het team om data echt te gaan gebruiken in het toezicht. Zo kunnen we straks beter controleren of instellingen zich aan de regels houden, risico’s inschatten en slimme technologie zoals AI inzetten om ons werk sneller en efficiënter te maken. Ook kijkt het team naar risico’s van nieuwe technologie in de financiële sector. Zo spelen we een belangrijke rol in het tijdig herkennen van risico’s.

 

De deadline voor deze vacature is 25 november 2026.


Dit vragen we:

⭐ Een afgeronde WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Data Science, Business Analytics, Wiskunde, Econometrie, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare (bèta) studie met een sterke analytische of statistische component.

⭐ Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring en kennis van het data/science werkveld en de daarbij behorende tools en technieken. Hierbij is ervaring met Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Python, Azure Data Bricks een vereiste.

⭐Kennis van softwareontwikkeling, versiebeheer, codereview en unit testing is vereist.

⭐ Analytisch sterk: het vermogen om complexe datasets te analyseren, patronen te herkennen en inzichten te genereren. Je neemt informatie niet zonder meer aan, toetst aannames en identificeert risico’s, afwijkingen en mogelijke blinde vlekken.

⭐ Proactieve houding: je werkt graag samen en draagt bij aan het gezamenlijke succes, tegelijkertijd kan je zelfstandig knopen doorhakken en analyses omzetten in concrete en bruikbare uitkomsten.

⭐ Communicatieve vaardigheden: je kunt complexe technische informatie helder en beknopt overbrengen aan niet of minder-technische collega’s. Ervaring met datavisualisatie om gegevens begrijpelijk en toegankelijk te presenteren voor verschillende belanghebbenden.

 

Please note: excellent proficiency in Dutch, both verbal and written, is required for this position.

 

Wat wij bieden:

📄 Je start met een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

💰 Afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring word je ingeschaald in schaal F (junior, met een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €52.500 en €87.000) of schaal G (medior, met een bruto jaarsalaris tussen €62.000 en €103.500). Bedragen zijn op basis van een 36-urige werkweek, inclusief 13e maand en vakantiegeld

⏰ 36-urige werkweek, werkdagen in overleg (bijv. 4x9)

🌴 199,5 vakantie-uren per jaar (bovenop je standaard roostervrije dag)

💻 Een laptop en een smartphone

📚 Uitgebreide trainings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden

🚆 Volledige vergoeding van OV-reiskosten (2e klas)

🏡 Thuiswerkvergoeding voor thuiswerkdagen

💪 Bijdrage aan een sportschoolabonnement

🚲 Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een fiets- en deviceregeling en vergoeding voor je thuiswerkplek

title: Student Loan Servicing Specialist | Remote USA | AI Training
description:
Job Description

Our client is seeking experienced Student Loan Servicing Specialists to contribute their expertise to an innovative artificial intelligence project focused on improving the accuracy, reliability, and quality of AI-generated guidance related to U.S. federal student loans.

In this remote contractor role, professionals will apply their practical knowledge of federal student loan servicing to evaluate AI-generated responses, identify inaccuracies, and provide detailed feedback that helps improve next-generation AI systems.

No previous experience in artificial intelligence is required. The primary qualification is hands-on expertise assisting federal student loan borrowers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze sample inquiries from federal student loan borrowers to assess the accuracy and completeness of servicing guidance.

  • Develop clear, detailed evaluation rubrics defining correct responses to complex borrower questions.

  • Evaluate AI-generated answers for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with current federal student loan policies and regulations.

  • Identify and document errors, omissions, outdated information, and inconsistencies in AI-generated responses.

  • Apply practical knowledge of federal repayment plans, including income-driven repayment options and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).

  • Assess complex servicing scenarios involving payment count discrepancies, misapplied payments, loan consolidation, and transfers between loan servicers.

  • Provide precise, actionable written feedback to improve AI system performance.

  • Complete assigned evaluations independently and asynchronously while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.

Position Details

  • Job Title: Student Loan Servicing Specialist

  • Location: United States — 100% Remote

  • Employment Type: Independent Contractor

  • Time Commitment: 15–25 hours per week

  • Compensation: USD $30–$50 per hour

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with direct experience in federal student loan servicing who are interested in applying their industry knowledge to innovative AI development projects.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Knowledge

  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal student loan programs, including federal loan types and repayment options.

  • Comprehensive understanding of income-driven repayment plans and current federal student loan regulations.

  • Knowledge of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), including qualifying payments and payment count calculations.

  • Familiarity with deferment, forbearance, delinquency, default, loan rehabilitation, and consolidation.

  • Ability to identify and resolve student loan servicing issues, including misapplied payments, payment count discrepancies, and loan servicer transfers.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail when reviewing complex borrower scenarios.

  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, accurate, and actionable feedback.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote, asynchronous environment.

  • Must be based in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of professional experience working for a federal student loan servicer or contractor supporting borrowers.

  • Direct experience in borrower assistance, loan servicing, default management, collections, or escalations.

  • Experience resolving complex federal student loan servicing problems.

  • Familiarity with recent regulatory changes and evolving federal student loan repayment policies.

  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex financial and regulatory concepts clearly and accurately.

  • Experience evaluating written responses, reviewing documentation, or performing quality assurance assessments.

Important Considerations

  • Previous experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning is not required.

  • Practical, hands-on experience in federal student loan servicing is highly valued.

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote — United States Only
Contract Type: Independent Contractor
Weekly Commitment: 15–25 hours
Compensation: USD $30–$50 per hour
Work Schedule: Flexible, asynchronous assignments

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Apply your professional expertise in federal student loan servicing to innovative artificial intelligence projects.

  • Work remotely from anywhere within the United States.

  • Enjoy a flexible, part-time commitment while contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems.

  • No prior experience in artificial intelligence or machine learning is required.

Our client is a U.S.-based organization engaged in innovative artificial intelligence projects, leveraging specialized industry expertise to improve the accuracy, reliability, and performance of next-generation AI systems.

For this project, our client is seeking experienced professionals in federal student loan servicing to contribute their practical knowledge of borrower assistance, repayment programs, loan servicing regulations, and complex borrower cases.

CONFISA Group is supporting the recruitment of qualified professionals for this remote opportunity across the United States.

title: Cloud Engineer Automation
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. 
  • Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 


\n
$120,000 - $140,000 a year
\n

title: Operations Efficiency Intern
description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

You will be an intern on the Customer Delight team at Back Market supporting operational efficiency for the Customer Care, Shipping & Seller Quality teams.

We act as the performance accelerators, combining technical expertise with operational knowledge to improve team and individual efficiency across Back Market's global operations.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • 40%: Automation & Operational Efficiency

    • Key action(s): Support the identification, prioritization, and creation of automation opportunities across Customer Delight, based on factors such as frequency, manual effort, and potential time saved.

    • Contribute to the testing, documentation, and continuous improvement of automations, workflows, and AI agents built with tools such as Dust, Workato, or similar platforms.

    • Help improve processes by applying Lean Six Sigma and Continuous Improvement methodologies, and by sharing ideas, observations, and practical solutions with stakeholders.

  • 40% Business & Data analysis

    • Assist with the automation of recurring reporting, data collection, analysis, and other operational tasks.

    • Help build and test automated insights and reports to ensure they are accurate, actionable, and useful for the teams who receive them.

    • Contribute to root cause analyses to better understand operational pain points and identify opportunities for sustainable improvement.

    • Assist the team in monitoring key performance indicators and operational efficiency metrics on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.

  • 20% AI Adoption & Support

    • Support the Operations Efficiency Specialist in promoting the use of AI and automation tools across Customer Delight teams.

    • Help prepare simple examples, guides, and training materials to support the onboarding of internal teams to AI tools and workflows.

    • Collect feedback from users and help identify barriers to adoption or opportunities to improve existing use cases.

Bonus point :

  • Familiar with Lean Six Sigma and Continuous Improvement methodologies

  • Experience with workflow automation or AI tools

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are pursuing a Master’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, Data, or a related field, with an internship agreement.

  • You are interested in using data, process analysis, technology, automation, and AI to improve how teams work.

  • You are comfortable with, or willing to learn, tools such as SQL, Google Sheets, Omnii, Dust, and Workato.

  • You have an analytical, organized, and autonomous mindset, with strong problem-solving skills.

  • You enjoy understanding operational processes and explaining technical topics to non-technical audiences.

  • You are fluent in spoken and written English and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

  • Additional languages and knowledge of Lean Six Sigma or Continuous Improvement are a plus.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP: ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months

  • Full-time internship (35h/week - Monday to Friday)

  • Location: Bordeaux, France

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

  • Video-call Interview with the Campus Team Member/ the recruiter

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Compensation: €1.1K – €1.3K per month

  • • Bordeaux-based Internship salary range, depending on study level €1.1K – €1.3K per month

title: Clinical Trial Coordinator (Coordinator, Rater Services)
description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Coordinator, Rater Services responsible for supporting multiple operational activities and functional areas to ensure the successful delivery of Cogstate's Rater Services programs and clinical trial support activities. The Coordinator, Rater Services will provide flexible, cross-functional support across a variety of service areas and serve as a key point of coordination between internal teams, study stakeholders, and external customers.

As workloads naturally fluctuate throughout the lifecycle of clinical trials and departmental initiatives, the Coordinator, Rater Services will be cross-trained across multiple operational functions and will work collaboratively with different teams, stepping in where support is needed most. Functional areas may include:

  • Rater Training
  • Central Monitoring
  • Central Rating
  • Scale Management
  • Study Administration and Reporting
  • Additional operational functions as deemed necessary to support business and study needs

The Coordinator, Rater Services is responsible for maintaining accurate documentation, supporting operational reporting, coordinating communications, and delivering exceptional customer service to sites, clinicians, raters, CRAs, sponsors, institutions, and internal stakeholders. The role also contributes to quality management and operational oversight by ensuring processes and deliverables are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate day-to-day operational activities supporting the delivery of clinical trials and Rater Services programs.
  • Serve as a point of contact for sites, clinicians, raters, CRAs, sponsors, and internal stakeholders, providing timely support and communication.
  • Maintain accurate study documentation, trackers, reports, and records while managing high-volume communications and scheduling activities.
  • Support study start-up, conduct, and close-out activities across Rater Training, Central Monitoring, Central Rating, Scale Management, and other operational functions as needed.
  • Monitor study progress and follow up on outstanding actions to help ensure project timelines and deliverables are met.
  • Assist with operational reporting, quality activities, and tracking deliverables against project requirements.
  • Collaborate with Study Managers and functional teams to provide flexible support across multiple operational areas and changing business priorities.
  • Manage assigned responsibilities in accordance with company SOPs, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives and support additional operational activities as required.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree and/or 1+ years of relevant experience.

  • Clinical research, healthcare, operations, customer service, project coordination, or related industry experience preferred.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Japanese OR Mandarin.
  • Ability to multi-task while remaining highly organized, methodical, and detail-oriented.
  • Strong people skills within the team and with customers and third-party providers.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, work independently, plan effectively, and be proactive.
  • Strong level of computer literacy; experience working with clinical software and systems is preferred.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, growing environment.
  • Strong customer service mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and support multiple functional areas as business needs evolve.

Essential Skills & Experience:

  • People skills: within the team, and with customers and third-party providers, strong desire to learn, to seek feedback on performance and to learn quickly.
  • Communication skills: both written and oral, providing operational support and conflict resolution
  • Work skills: eye for detail, problem solving, compulsion to check and double-check work product, ability to work fast, impeccable record keeping and compliance to procedures, high level of computer literacy (Excel/Office savvy).
  • Good organizational skills: handling multiple tasks, establishing and managing competing priorities, ability to work independently and to be proactive

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work remotely from wherever they are located in the United States.
  • Generous Paid Time-off: Cogstate employees receive 20 days of vacation leave, 10 days of personal leave and 10 paid public holidays.
  • 401(k) Matching: As you invest in yourself and your future, Cogstate invests in you too: we match up to3% of your yearly salary in Cogstate’s 401k program.
  • Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the position.
  • Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
  • Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
  • Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.

Wage Range

$90,000—$100,000 AUD

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the company. If you need assistance in applying please email PeopleandCulture@cogstate.com.

Privacy Notice for Job Applicants

Cogstate is committed to protecting your personal data. We collect and process your information for recruitment purposes in compliance with applicable laws, including the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), and similar laws in other jurisdictions.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

description:
About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MD/DO).

  • Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

  • Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

  • Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

  • Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

  • Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

  • Location: Fully remote

  • Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

  • Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

  • Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

  • Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

  • Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

  • Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

title: Product Designer
description:
About Us
Gather AI is the Physical AI platform for logistics. We give the companies that run the world’s warehouses ground truth on every product and every movement, dock to dock.
Our platform reads the warehouse floor through autonomous drones and cameras mounted on material handling equipment, then turns what it sees into intelligence and action. Facilities run safer and more accurately, with fewer ladders and fewer manual counts. If you want to do the defining design work for a new category in a vital industry, we’d like to meet you.
About the Team
Product at Gather AI sits at an unusual intersection: we build software for people who work on warehouse floors, not at desks. Our users are associates checking inventory on a tablet from the seat of a forklift, shift teams running drone workflows, field technicians troubleshooting on site, and facility leaders reading AI-generated insights in Sage.
Design here is about more than pixels, though craft matters a lot. It starts with understanding how people work under pressure, and it ends with software that gets out of their way and looks as advanced as the technology behind it.
About the Role
Most design roles ask you to improve something that already exists. This one asks you to define what good looks like for a new category of product.
You’ll be Gather AI’s first and only designer. You’ll own design end to end, from field research and information architecture to visual craft and working prototypes. Your work spans the apps floor teams use alongside our drones and MHE Vision systems, and Sage, our AI insights layer. The job is to help the product team ship products that solve real problems and happen to be very well designed, not to make screens for their own sake.
You won’t design from assumptions. You’ll stand next to the people using our software and let what you see shape what you build.
We’d love you near our Pittsburgh office, and we’ll seriously consider strong candidates anywhere in the US. The role includes about 20% travel, roughly one trip a month, to customer sites in Houston and Dallas and to our Pittsburgh office.
There’s no established design team to slot into, and that’s the point. You’ll set the standard and build the foundations, with a visible path to Director of UX as design at Gather AI grows.
What You’ll Do

  • Own design for the MHEV app: ramp fast and propose a v2 concept by month 3, then take full ownership of the product line
  • Design interfaces for people working directly with drones and forklifts: tablet experiences used mid-shift, in noisy environments and under time pressure, where clarity is the whole job
  • Expand into the Sage dashboard as your second product line, shaping an AI insights product that’s early enough for your decisions to define its direction
  • Build on the foundations of the Gather design system and own it across our dashboards and apps
  • Travel to customer sites to observe how people use our products in the field, and bring that context into every design decision
  • Partner closely with mobile and front-end engineering in Pittsburgh and Noida, from MHEV stand-ups and weekly requirements planning through handoffs that remove ambiguity rather than create it
  • Use Claude and other AI tools to move from concept to functioning prototype, and design with an eye to how engineers will use your work with AI to build front ends faster. The team moves fast and expects you to as well
  • Over time, extend your work to internal tools and the occasional piece of marketing material

What You’ll Need

  • Visual craft: a portfolio with strong, simple, modern design that holds up even in data-dense interfaces. We look closely at typography and layout
  • Analytical rigor: you turn data and requirements into clear information hierarchy, and you can show how you knew a design worked, through measures like task time, error rates or training time
  • Experience shipping real products at scale, with users in real workflows, where we can see the thinking behind the screens
  • A desire to be the only designer: you want to own design end to end now, without a larger design team around you
  • Comfort using Claude or other AI tools to build working prototypes, not just static Figma designs
  • Experience designing through user research: you’ve watched people work and changed what you built because of it
  • Figma fluency, or deep experience with a comparable design and prototyping tool
  • The ability to work without a lot of structure: spot what needs designing before you’re asked, and ask good questions when you’re stuck
  • Willingness to travel about 20% of the time (roughly one trip a month) to customer warehouses and our Pittsburgh office

Nice to Have

title: Technical Oversight - Underwriting
description:
About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.

About The Role

We’re seeking an entrepreneurial Technical Oversight - Underwriting. This role involves both strategic oversight and hands-on management of third party fulfillment providers to ensure efficient, compliant loan origination while enhancing systems and workflows for high-quality, scalable operations.

You will be instrumental in shaping the future of our platform, developing underwriting workflows, standard operating procedures, and quality control measures. You will provide tactical guidance to engineering teams, emphasizing scalable human out of the loop solutions.

We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about building flexible automated systems with rigorous oversight that can scale, this role is for you.

About You

  • Possess expert-level knowledge of the entire mortgage lending process, detailed underwriting knowledge specific to loan requirements and comprehensive understanding of federal, state, and regulatory guidelines related to residential mortgage lending.

  • You are a visionary leader with a clear perspective on building scalable, modular origination infrastructure.

  • Comfortable operating in highly regulated industry whilst optimizing for performance. You build with a compliance first lens, respect regulations, continuously review, and update processes as needed.

  • Obsess over the customer and uphold the highest standard. You build for our customers and their borrowers, doing whatever it takes to make them successful on the platform.

  • Adhere to a scalable software first approach, operational workaround last. You surface issues, lead discussions around long-term solutions, document them, and manage temporary manual workarounds if needed.

  • Ability to oversee numerous 3rd party fulfillment partners, ensuring high quality, on-time originations. You build deep relationships and drive consistent results.

  • Have strong, principled opinions that you’re willing to defend. We have a culture of vigorous discussion and debate on decisions. We’ll push you to articulate your choices, and defend them where necessary.

  • Have great ideas, and lots of them. You should see opportunities all around you to make the product and team better. We’ll provide the environment to act on those ideas.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement underwriting workflows, SOPs, SLAs, checklists, and QC measures to ensure high-quality and efficient loan underwriting.

  • Regularly access and enhance our Underwriting Systems to ensure smooth file flow, high quality, regulatory compliance and efficiency.

  • Oversee day-to-day operations with fulfillment partners, ensuring consistent loan delivery.

  • Define and monitor productivity standards and performance goals and ensure that they are met on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis.

  • Conducting 2nd level reviews, handling exceptions, and managing escalations to ensure quality control.

  • Act as a subject matter expert, aiding decision-making and driving product improvement.

  • Working closely with internal teams, partners, and engineering to drive product improvements and optimize the fulfillment infrastructure.

  • Provide technical and guideline training, recommend areas of improvement, and conduct ongoing training as needed.

  • Maintain a comprehensive understanding of mortgage origination and regulations to ensure compliance.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in underwriting and managing underwriting teams across diverse loan types, including Conventional, Jumbo, NON-QM, GOVT across purchase and refinance.

  • Proven track record in developing underwriting workflows, SOPs, SLAs,and QC measures.

  • Proficiency in configuring Underwriting Systems for efficiency,quality and compliance.

  • Proven track record in managing and leading de-centralized underwriting teams.

  • Experience in the management of strategic 3rd party fulfillment partners.

  • Experience working on mortgage products within a fintech environment is strongly preferred.

Benefits

  • Ownership: Meaningful early-stage equity in Pylon.

  • Healthcare: Top-tier medical, vision & dental with support for dependents.

  • 401(k): Ability to save for your future.

  • Flexible Time Off: Be on when you’re on and off when you’re off.

  • Hardware Allowance: $2,000 to fix up your workspace.

  • Annual Off-sites: Fully paid for team off-sites in beautiful corners of the world.

  • At-cost Mortgages: We’ll help you finance your next home when you’re ready.

You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.
