title: Talent Acquisition Partner-Europe
description:
DeepHealth is seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner based in Europe to own high-impact, full-cycle recruiting across European markets and support global hiring as needed. This is a hands-on execution role in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where searches are varied, specialized, and rarely repeatable. The successful candidate will combine a strong B2B SaaS recruiting background with exceptional organization, proactive sourcing, and strategic hiring manager partnership, developing a deep understanding of each position and delivering tailored hiring strategies. This position contributes to continuous improvement of an evolving global Talent Acquisition function but is not responsible for building or leading the function.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruitment across multiple European markets, with additional support for US, Canadian, and APAC hiring as business needs require.

  • Manage a high-volume, diverse portfolio of technical, commercial, product, and corporate requisitions while maintaining quality and responsiveness.

  • Lead detailed intake meetings to understand business objectives, essential competencies, technical requirements, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles for each distinct search.

  • Develop tailored sourcing and assessment strategies for niche and business-critical roles; proactively engage passive candidates through direct sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and professional networks.

  • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and leaders; advise on talent markets, compensation expectations, hiring feasibility, and selection strategy.

  • Challenge and refine role requirements constructively, distinguish must-haves from preferences, and proactively address obstacles to hiring.

  • Coordinate screening, interviewing, feedback, offer development, negotiation, and hiring handoffs while delivering timely, transparent candidate communication.

  • Independently prioritize competing requisitions, manage calendars and deadlines, maintain strong follow-through, and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

  • Maintain accurate ATS records and provide regular reporting on pipeline health, time-to-fill, sourcing effectiveness, bottlenecks, and hiring progress.

  • Use recruiting technology, AI-assisted tools, and appropriate automation to improve sourcing and execution efficiency while preserving sound judgment and human oversight.

  • Ensure hiring activities comply with relevant country-specific employment requirements, GDPR, data privacy standards, and DeepHealth policies.

  • Partner with the global People and Communications teams to strengthen DeepHealth’s employer brand across European markets.

  • Plan and deliver local talent-attraction initiatives, such as recruitment events, university or professional-community partnerships, networking activities and employee referral campaigns.

  • Build relationships with local universities, professional associations and talent communities to develop pipelines for priority roles.

  • Represent DeepHealth professionally and communicate its mission and employer value proposition throughout the candidate journey.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on full-cycle Talent Acquisition experience, including substantial recruiting experience within B2B SaaS organizations (required).

  • Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple European countries and navigating differences in talent markets, employment practices, and hiring processes (required).

  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of varied, complex requisitions across multiple job families rather than repeated hiring for a single profile (required).

  • Experience recruiting technical roles such as Software Engineering, Cloud/DevOps, Product, Data Science, or AI/ML, alongside commercial or corporate functions (required).

  • Strong direct sourcing capability, including passive candidate engagement and role-specific market mapping (required).

  • Demonstrated ability to build strategic relationships with hiring managers and senior stakeholders, advise on hiring strategy, and influence decisions (required).

  • Exceptional time management, prioritization, organization, communication, and attention to detail (required).

  • Experience with applicant tracking systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, recruiting metrics, and modern sourcing tools (required).

  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English and ability to collaborate across international time zones (required).

  • Experience developing employer-brand activity or delivering local talent-attraction initiatives, such as recruitment events, university partnerships, professional-community engagement or employee advocacy (preferred).

  • Experience recruiting into the United States, Canada, and APAC (preferred).

  • Experience in healthcare technology, enterprise imaging, PACS/RIS, radiology software, or clinical AI (preferred).

  • Experience supporting global SaaS organizations, including Employer of Record arrangements, and familiarity with Recruitee or comparable ATS platforms (preferred).

  • Additional European language proficiency (preferred).

Quality Standards

  • Communicates and collaborates professionally with colleagues, candidates, hiring managers, and external partners.

  • Demonstrates initiative, integrity, discretion, accountability, and confidentiality in all areas of performance.

  • Follows applicable local, regional, and country employment laws, including data privacy requirements.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies, procedures, safety, and compliance standards.

  • Adapts to new priorities, tools, systems, and ways of working.

  • Completes responsibilities accurately, efficiently, and within agreed timelines.

Travel

This position may require occasional global travel of up to 10%, based on business needs.

Working Environment

Remote (Europe); specific employing country and work arrangement subject to confirmation.

Physical Demands

The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

title: Inside Sales Contractor
description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Post Training:

We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:

Monday - Friday

Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows:

  • 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM EST

  • 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM EST

  • 9:00 AM - 5:00 AM EST

  • 9:30 AM - 5:30 PM EST

  • 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST

title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

title: Strategy & Operations Coach APAC
description:
About The Role

We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

  • Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

  • Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

  • Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

  • Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

  • Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

Who are you?

You areâ¦

  • A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

  • Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

  • Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

  • A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

  • Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

  • Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

  • Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

Other details

  • This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

  • You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

  • You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

  • This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

  • Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there.

Inclusion Statement:
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the requirements.

title: Registered Nurse
description:
Company: Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc.
Position Type: Per Diem
Work Arrangement: Field-Based â Patient Home Visits
Compensation: $110â$130 per visit

Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. The RN will assess patient and family needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, administer prescribed medications and treatments, educate patients and caregivers, and coordinate care with physicians and other healthcare professionals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong clinical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. This role also involves discharge planning, case management when assigned, and supervising and evaluating home health aide services to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care.

If you are passionate about helping patients maintain their independence and well-being at home, we encourage you to join our team.

Note: This is a field-based, per diem position that requires travel to patientsâ homes. Although listed as âremote,â this is not a work-from-home or telehealth role.

Responsibilities
    • Conduct initial patient and family assessments to determine home health care needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
    • Regularly reassess patientsâ nursing needs and evaluate changes in their conditions.
    • Initiate and revise individualized plans of care as patient status and needs change.
    • Use assessment findings to establish nursing diagnoses and develop appropriate care plans.
    • Develop care plans that establish patient-centered goals and incorporate therapeutic, preventive, and rehabilitative nursing interventions.
    • Involve patients and their families in care planning and decision-making.
    • Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by the physician.
    • Implement appropriate preventive and rehabilitative nursing procedures.
    • Counsel patients and families regarding nursing and related healthcare needs.
    • Provide patient and caregiver education based on assessments and the established plan of care.
    • Identify discharge planning needs during care planning and implement appropriate arrangements before patient discharge.
    • Serve as case manager when assigned by the Clinical Supervisor or Nursing Supervisor, coordinating care for the assigned patient caseload.
    • Prepare accurate clinical notes and update the primary physician as needed and at least every 60 days.
    • Communicate patient needs and changes in condition to physicians, and obtain or receive physician orders as required.
    • Coordinate with community healthcare professionals and other relevant parties to support the patient's plan of care.
    • Participate in on-call duties according to organizational policy.
    • Ensure arrangements for necessary equipment, supplies, and other patient services.
    • Instruct, supervise, and evaluate home health aide services provided to patients every two weeks.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned to support patient care.
    • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
    • Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in California.
    • At least 1â2 years of recent acute care experience in an institutional setting.
    • Current CPR certification.
    • Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle insured in accordance with state and organizational requirements.
    • Excellent observation and clinical assessment skills.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Effective problem-solving skills and basic mathematical skills.
    • Ability to perform nursing duties according to established competency requirements.
    • Ability to work independently and coordinate patient care responsibilities.
    • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with patient care, including prolonged standing or walking, lifting supplies and equipment, and assisting with patient positioning or transfers, with applicable accommodations.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in nursing.
    • At least 1 year of home health care experience.

Additional role responsibility: The RN is responsible for supervising home health aides. Previous management experience is not required.

title: Sales Development Representative DACH
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

3 days per week in our Berlin office

Build your enterprise sales career at n8n

n8n is growing rapidly at the intersection of AI, automation and enterprise software. More than 1.7 million active builders use n8n each month, and we’re scaling our enterprise business as more organisations look for ways to connect AI with the systems, data and workflows that run their businesses.

We’re building our SDR team in Berlin and looking for an Enterprise Sales Development Representative to join us.

You’ll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to break into some of the largest organisations in the DACH region. This isn’t about maximising email volume. You’ll take a thoughtful, account-based approach: researching strategic companies, identifying the right stakeholders, understanding their priorities, and creating relevant conversations around automation and AI.

If you’re succeeding in an SDR/BDR role and want greater exposure to enterprise selling, strategic account planning, technical buyers and a genuine path towards AE, this could be a great next step.

Why n8n?

🚀 Serious momentum. n8n has grown rapidly into a major player in workflow automation and AI, with more than $100M in ARR, 1,400+ enterprise customers, and a $5.2B valuation following strategic investment from SAP.

📈 Build towards AE. We want the SDR role to be a platform for your next step. High-performing SDRs can develop through our structured SDR → AE programme, with live deal exposure, discovery and MEDDPICC coaching, call reviews, and opportunities to take greater ownership of real opportunities alongside experienced AEs.

✏️ Learn enterprise selling. Work alongside Enterprise AEs on account strategy, stakeholder mapping, messaging, discovery and opportunity creation - gaining exposure to how complex enterprise deals are built from the start.

🤖 Sell where the market is going. You’ll engage technical and executive buyers around AI, automation and some of the most important technology challenges businesses are tackling today.

⚡Use AI to sell smarter. Experiment with AI, n8n and modern sales technology to research accounts, understand buyers, personalise outreach and improve how you work. You don’t need to be an engineer - but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn.

What you’ll do

  • Build enterprise pipeline: Prospect into a focused set of strategic accounts and create qualified opportunities.

  • Develop account strategies: Partner with Enterprise AEs to identify priority companies, stakeholders, challenges, use cases and engagement strategies.

  • Research your prospects: Understand the business and technical priorities of stakeholders across IT, DevOps, SecOps, Engineering and related teams.

  • Create outreach that gets attention: Develop thoughtful, personalised messaging tied to real account priorities rather than generic sequences.

  • Prospect across channels: Engage prospects through email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

  • Lead early-stage discovery: Understand business needs, technical environments, priorities, urgency and potential fit with n8n.

  • Continuously improve: Use Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, AI tools, coaching and performance data to sharpen your approach.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone with a strong SDR foundation who wants to develop into an excellent enterprise seller.

You’ll likely be a good fit if you have:

  • SDR or BDR experience in B2B SaaS, software or technology

  • Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting within mid- market or enterprise accounts

  • A strong sales track record against your targets

  • Fluency in German (C1 level- fluent or bilingual)

  • Confidence engaging senior business and technical stakeholders

  • A thoughtful approach to account research, personalisation and qualification

  • Curiosity about technical products, automation and AI

  • Resilience, consistency and ownership of your results

  • The ability to work from our Berlin office three days per week

Bonus points if you have: experience prospecting into technical audiences; familiarity with buying committees, Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo or MEDDPICC; experience using AI or automation in your own sales workflow.

What success looks like

Success here is about quality, not just activity.

You’ll build a deep understanding of your accounts, identify the right stakeholders, create messaging that earns attention and generate qualified enterprise opportunities that can turn into meaningful revenue.

Along the way, you’ll build experience in enterprise account strategy, technical selling, discovery, AI and automation, and complex B2B sales - giving you a strong foundation for the next stage of your career.

Interested?

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply.

If you have a strong foundation in outbound sales, you’re curious about technology, and you’re excited by the opportunity to help build n8n’s enterprise business while developing towards your next step in sales, we’d love to hear from you.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - FR/BNL/SE (m/f/x)
description:
Account Executive (m/f/x) (French Speaking) 

Location: EU 

(Remote) 

Comp: 120k EUR base 

Territories: France / Benelux / Southern Europe 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Account Executives who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Own and grow a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across France / Benelux / Southern Europe. 

  • Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion. 

  • Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts. 

  • Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners. 

  • Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles. 

  • Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities. 

  • Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value. 

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. 


  • Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills. 

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. 

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. 

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. 

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. 

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. 

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. 

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. 

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. 

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. 

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. 

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. 

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. 

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. 

  • Nice to have: experience selling services. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer:

title: Elektroplaner Smart Home als Content Creator (m/w/d)
description:
Remote · 4-Tage-Woche möglich · 50.000–80.000 € p. a. (Vollzeit)

„Smart Home oder konventionell?“ Die Frage landet immer bei dir, weil du dich sehr gut auskennst und auch gut erklären kannst? Dann komm zu uns und mach genau das zu deinem Job!

JETPLAN entwickelt die Zukunft der Elektroplanung – für Elektrohandwerk, Planer und Bauwirtschaft.

Wir suchen eine Person, die echte Planungspraxis aus dem Wohnbau mitbringt und daraus Videos, Musterplanungen und How-tos für YouTube und Social Media macht. Du bist das Gesicht, das zeigt, wie moderne und zunehmend KI-gestützte Elektroplanung mit JETPLAN funktioniert.

Dein Fachwissen ist dabei der Kern: Nur wer selbst plant, kann komplexe Themen so erklären, dass Elektriker und Bauherren wirklich etwas davon haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du produzierst How-to-Videos, Tutorials und Kurzformate für YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram & Co. Dabei erklärst du, wie typische Kundenwünsche in JETPLAN planerisch dargestellt werden.

  • Du erstellst normkonforme Musterplanungen für typische Wohnbauprojekte – vom Einfamilienhaus bis zur Wohnung, konventionell und Smart Home.

  • Du zeigst Systeme wie KNX, Loxone und DALI im Planungsalltag: Wann passt was, worauf kommt es an?

  • Du entwickelst Themen- und Formatideen mit und greifst Fragen aus der Community auf.

  • Mit deiner Planungserfahrung bringst du wertvolle Impulse in die Produktentwicklung ein.

Dein Publikum: Elektriker, Planer und planungsinteressierte Bauherren.

Wohin die Rolle wachsen kann

Im Kern geht es ums Planen, Erklären und Beraten vor der Kamera. Wenn du Lust und Erfahrung mitbringst, kann die Rolle deutlich strategischer werden: Du gestaltest die Content-Ausrichtung mit – welche Zielgruppen, welche Themen, wo Longform, wo Shortform –, spielst Inhalte gezielt über YouTube, Suche und Social Ads aus und wertest aus, welche Inhalte wirklich Anfragen bringen. Wie weit das geht, entscheiden wir gemeinsam – je nachdem, was du mitbringst.

Das bringst du mit

Du musst nicht aus einem Planungsbüro kommen: Quereinsteiger mit elektrotechnischer Ausbildung sind herzlich willkommen, vor allem aus dem Elektrohandwerk.

Das ist uns wichtig

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Planung von Elektroinstallationen, konventionell und Smart Home, mit Schwerpunkt Wohnbau (komplexe Anlagen, Zweckbau oder Industrie musst du nicht beherrschen)

  • Sichere Kenntnisse gängiger Systeme wie KNX, Loxone, DALI etc.

  • Du kannst gut beraten und Zusammenhänge einfach erklären

  • Du stehst gern vor der Kamera, nimmst dich ohne Scheu beim Planen auf und hast eine natürliche Präsenz

  • Echte Freude an Elektroplanung und Smart Home

  • Fließendes Deutsch (zwingend)

Schön, aber kein Muss

  • Kenntnisse in der Lichtplanung

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Erfahrung mit Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt

  • Eigene Kanäle oder erste Content-Erfahrung auf YouTube oder Social Media

  • Erfahrung mit Content-Strategie, SEO oder Performance-Marketing

Das bieten wir

  • 100 % remote: Du arbeitest von dort, wo du am besten planst und aufnimmst.

  • 4-Tage-Woche möglich: Mehr Zeit für dich – bei gleichem Anspruch an deine Arbeit.

  • Gehalt: 50.000–80.000 € brutto pro Jahr bei 100 %, je nach Qualifikation

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst Formate und Inhalte von Anfang an mit – und wenn du willst, auch die gesamte Content-Ausrichtung.

  • Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründerteam, Entscheidungen fallen schnell – ohne Politik, allein danach, was unseren Kunden wirklich hilft.

  • KI-Planung von Anfang an: Du arbeitest mit den neuesten Planungswerkzeugen und prägst, wie sie im Alltag funktionieren.

Bewirb dich – gern mit Video

Du brennst für Elektroplanung? Wir freuen uns auf dich! Nutze den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite, um uns deinen Lebenslauf, deine Gehaltsvorstellung und deinen frühesten Starttermin zu senden.

Statt eines Anschreibens freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Video (freiwillig, 1–3 Minuten, Handy reicht): Stell dich vor und erklär uns ein Smart-Home-Thema deiner Wahl – zum Beispiel, wann du KNX und wann Loxone empfiehlst. Falls vorhanden, verlinke gern Arbeitsproben oder eigene Kanäle.

title: Accident & Health Claims Handler
description:
Building a More Resilient World

When things go wrong, insurance has one job: get people and businesses back on their feet. Too often, it doesn’t. At ClaimSorted, we’re changing that, and building a more resilient world where people and businesses have the confidence to go after bigger opportunities.

We’re creating the company that will define how claims are handled for the next generation. The world’s largest insurers and Fortune 500 companies already trust us to handle their claims and manage their risk.

And we’re moving fast. We grew 10x in the past year, raised one of the largest InsurTech rounds of its kind, and are backed by Y Combinator, Atomico and Eurazeo. We ship, learn and improve every week, never settling for “how it’s always been done.”

We’re just getting started. There’s never been a better time to join.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Accident and Health Claims Handler to join ClaimSorted and support the launch of our first A&H account. You’ll lead the charge in growing this line of business, delivering outstanding customer care, making decisions independently and driving efficiencies in a brand new area of the business.

This role is ideal for:

  • an experienced A&H Claims Handler who wants to build their career at a company that rewards performance, not tenure

  • someone confident applying their own judgement, who is hungry to learn and grow fast and wants to shape how a new line of business is run

We are not looking for tenure for the sake of it. We are looking for people with talent, ambition, work ethic, and the drive to build a real career.

If you join us, we will give you the training and support to become the best Claims Handler possible, from people management to performance management, data, quality, and capacity planning. Our goal is to help you become one of the best claims leaders of the future.

What You’ll Do

  • Handle A&H claims end to end, from first notification of loss through to settlement

  • Review and interpret medical evidence to assess claims accurately against policy terms

  • Communicate with policyholders throughout the claims journey, ensuring a clear, empathetic and positive experience

  • Verify coverage and make confident, independent decisions within your authority

  • Set appropriate reserves and manage your claims to closure targets

  • Proactively manage outstanding claims, keeping them moving and chasing evidence where needed

  • Identify potential fraud indicators and escalate appropriately

  • Maintain accurate and thorough claims records for audit and compliance

  • Help shape processes for our first A&H account, and contribute to continuous improvement by flagging inefficiencies

What Success Looks Like

  • Accurate, high quality decisions, with a 95% average QA score

  • Meeting 100% of claim closure targets and proactively managing outstanding claims

  • Answering 95% of emails within 1 business day

Who You Are

  • Based in the UK with work authorisation

  • Experienced in handling Accident and Health claims, with strong technical knowledge of medical evidence and A&H claim assessment principles

  • Confident making independent decisions and applying judgement

  • Excellent communicator, able to work well with policyholders, clients, medical professionals and colleagues

  • Strong organisation and ability to prioritise independently

  • Comfortable using data to make decisions

  • Team-oriented, hardworking, and ambitious

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coaching others is a plus

  • Startup or high-growth experience is a plus

Why Join Us

This is a chance to grow faster than you would at a traditional insurer or claims business.

You’ll get real responsibility, real training, and the opportunity to build your career in a high-performance environment that rewards talent and hard work. As part of the launch of our first A&H account, you’ll have a real hand in building and growing this line of business.

If you’re ready to step up, work hard, and build a career in claims, we’d love to hear from you.

Our Values

 

Move Fast – Act decisively, iterate quickly, optimize for momentum.

Always Overdeliver – We exceed expectations in everything we do.

Think Customer-First, Always – The customer experience drives every decision.

Challenge the Status Quo – We innovate relentlessly and never settle for 'good enough.'

Say It How It Is – Transparency and direct communication build trust.

 

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary beyond the industry standard

  • Quarterly performance bonus: up to 15% of quarterly salary

  • Generous, transparent equity participation

  • 28 days annual leave

  • Private medical insurance

  • Pension contributions

  • Company offsites

  • Accelerated promotion track in a high-growth environment

Compensation: £28K – £36K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • 15% Quaterly Bonus

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: Ingénieur(e) Développement (Projet Phygital) - CDD 12 mois
description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

🎯Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’ingénieur(e) de développement, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en formation, recherche et innovation affecté à l’Institut Henri FAYOL. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.

A l’heure actuelle, face aux besoins croissants d’acteurs pour accompagner les transitions des entreprises et de leurs écosystèmes territoriaux et industriels, Mines Saint-Etienne, dans le cadre du projet Phygital financé par la région AURA, a décidé de massifier ses formations i) en s’appuyant sur des pratiques innovantes en direction de publics hétérogènes (formation initiale, formation tout au long de la vie, formation par la recherche), et ii) en se basant sur de nombreux cas d’usages technologiques (Intelligence Artificielle, Sciences des données, Jumeaux Numériques, Gestion de production, etc), démonstrateurs des enjeux actuels de l’industrie et des territoires du futur. Ces cas d’usages technologiques sont développés à ce jour sur ses plateformes informatiques et industrielles du laboratoire des transitions, et doivent être déployés à grande échelle :

 

Dans ce cadre, vos différentes missions sont :

  • Intégrer les nouveaux composants connectés (robots mobiles, bras robotiques, convoyeurs, capteurs et actionneurs divers) et assurer leur fonctionnement avec le reste du matériel, notamment en déployant des interfaces interactives pour faciliter leur utilisation.

  • Aider à la conception de contenu pédagogique de douze modules définis comme prioritaire dans ce projet Phygital (Optimisation de systèmes de production, Instrumentation responsable pour le pilotage du territoire et de l’industrie, Système Information pour l’observation et le pilotage d’un territoire, Système Information pour le pilotage industrie (PLM/ERP/MES), Détection d'anomalies et maintenance prédictive, Jumeaux Numériques Flux et processus, Robotique de manipulation et de transitique, Assistance numérique opérateur, Cybersécurité, Intégration et ingénierie systèmes intelligents (couplage de différents modules pour constituer un système cyber-physique intelligent multifonction) en lien avec les plateformes et les logiciels développés).

  • Faciliter la maintenance les logiciels et matériels pour l’exploitation des composants connectés.

 

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir, notamment avec les autres ingénieurs de développement intervenant dans le périmètre du laboratoire des transitions.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de Master (Bac+5) ou équivalent et possédez :

• Une expérience confirmée en conception logicielle et/ou en intégration de systèmes

• Une bonne maîtrise de la programmation (notamment Python, C++ ou Java)

• Connaissances dans les technologies de l’IA

 

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

• Connaissances de l’environnement ROS (Robot Operating System)

• Conception d’interfaces utilisateurs et UX Design

• Collaboration passée avec des enseignants-chercheurs

• Intérêt pour la pédagogie et éventuellement, une expérience en enseignement

• Rigueur, travail en équipe, autonomie, proactivité

📩 Candidatez dès maintenant !

Date limite de candidature :  15/12/2026

🔗 Les dossiers de candidature (CV, lettre de motivation, lettre de recommandation le cas échéant, pièce d’identité) sont à déposer sur la plateforme RECRUITEE :

https://institutminestelecom.recruitee.com/o/ingenieure-developpement-projet-phygital-cdd-12-mois

Dans le cadre de sa politique Égalité, Diversité et Inclusion, l’École des Mines de Saint Etienne est un employeur soucieux de l’équité de traitement entre les candidatures.

Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 1er janvier 2027

ℹ️ Informations complémentaires

  • Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 12 mois

  • Localisation du poste : Saint-Étienne (42).

  • Rémunération fixée selon le profil du candidat, en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines Télécom.

  • Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap.

  • Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique (catégorie A - détaché sur contrat) et/ou aux personnes contractuelles).

  • À moyen terme, un poste pérenne est susceptible d’être ouvert.

  • Toute candidature peut faire l’objet d’une enquête administrative

  • A usage interne Institut Mines Télécom :

Ø  Catégorie II – Métier A – Ingénieur selon le Cadre de Gestion

Les candidatures sont examinées au fil de l’eau. Les candidats présélectionnés après examen de leur dossier seront convoqués à un entretien à Saint-Étienne ou à distance en visioconférence (le lien de connexion sera communiqué ultérieurement).

 

 📞 Contacts

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

  • Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

  • Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

  • Un soutien à l’intégration : indépendamment de la participation à nos projets de recherche, l’Institut Henri Fayol vous assure les moyens financiers pour présenter vos travaux à 1 conférence internationale et un stagiaire en soutien.

  • Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

title: Pre-Sales / Sales Engineer
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

  • Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

  • Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best;

  • Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;

  • Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

  • Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

  • Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

  • Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

  • Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities.

You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all!

Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, this role requires you to be based in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range.

⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️

  • You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role.

  • You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation;

  • You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment;

  • You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ;

  • You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions;

  • You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

  • You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments;

  • You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow;

  • You are fluent in both French and English;

It would be even better if you have:

  • Experience with end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s;

  • Experience in the French Public Sector;

  • Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions;

  • Experience in Insurance or Health platforms.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

title: R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • On-site Technical Panel (3x60 min)

.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Content Creator & Online Marketing
description:
Content Creator & Online Marketing (20 %)


Teilzeit (20 %)

Du liebst Social Media, hast kreative Ideen, bist KI-affin und weisst, wie man mit einem spannende Inhalte produziert? Dann suchen wir genau dich!

Die Hüsser & Palkoska AG ist ein vielseitiges Automobilunternehmen mit Standorten in Baar und Neuheim. Von der klassischen Werkstatt über Elektromobilität und Fahrzeughandel bis hin zu unserer neuen Carrosserie- und Lackiererei bieten wir ein breites Spektrum rund ums Automobil.

Wir möchten unsere Geschichten, unser Fachwissen und die Menschen hinter unserem Unternehmen noch stärker sichtbar machen. Dafür suchen wir eine kreative und selbstständige Persönlichkeit, die unseren digitalen Auftritt aktiv mitgestaltet.

Bei uns musst du keine aufwendigen Filmproduktionen erstellen. Wir setzen auf authentische Inhalte, gute Ideen und eine unkomplizierte Umsetzung mit Smartphone.

Was erwartet dich?

  • Selbstständige Ideenfindung und Entwicklung spannender Inhalte rund um unseren Betrieb

  • Planung, Produktion und Veröffentlichung von Videos

  • Filmen mit dem Smartphone an unseren Standorten

  • Durchführung von kurzen Interviews mit unseren Mitarbeitenden und Fachpersonen

  • Videoschnitt inklusive Musik, Untertiteln und passenden Effekten

  • Erstellung von Blogs die GEO und SEO

  • Optimierung der Blogbeiträge für Google und KI-basierte Suchmaschinen (SEO/GEO)

  • Erstellung und Pflege eines Marketing- und Redaktionsplans

  • Regelmässige Abstimmung der Marketingplanung mit der Geschäftsleitung

  • Beobachtung aktueller Social-Media-Trends und Einbringen neuer Ideen

  • Einfache Auswertung der veröffentlichten Inhalte und ihrer Reichweite

Was wünschen wir uns von dir?

  • Freude an Social Media

  • Erfahrung mit CapCut

  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem Smartphone für Video- und Fotoaufnahmen

  • Kreativität und ein gutes Gespür für interessante Geschichten

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und grosses Interesse diese effizient einzusetzen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Freude am Schreiben

  • Grundkenntnisse in Online-Marketing, SEO und Website-Pflege von Vorteil

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit Inhalte vorausschauend zu planen

  • Offene und kommunikative Persönlichkeit die gerne auf Menschen zugeht

  • Eigeninitiative: Du erkennst spannende Themen und setzt deine Ideen selbstständig um

  • Pragmatische Einstellung, du möchtest gute Inhalte produzieren, statt alles unnötig kompliziert zu machen

  • Wohnort vorzugsweise in der Region Zug

Wichtig zu wissen:

Ein wesentlicher Teil deiner Arbeit findet direkt in unseren Betrieben statt. Für Filmaufnahmen, Interviews und die Sammlung interessanter Geschichten bist du mindestens einen halben Tag pro Woche vor Ort.

Die Ideenfindung, Planung, Videobearbeitung und Texterstellung kannst du nach Absprache auch von zu Hause aus erledigen. Dafür verwendest du deine eigenen Geräte wie Smartphone und Laptop. An unseren Standorten stellen wir dir die notwendigen Arbeitsgeräte zur Verfügung. Für die Arbeit im Homeoffice werden keine Geräte bereitgestellt.

Eine vollständig remote ausgeführte Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was kannst du von uns erwarten?

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Teilzeitstelle

  • Viel Freiraum für eigene Ideen und kreative Umsetzungen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit klar geregelter Präsenz vor Ort

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung

  • Quantitativ klar geregelte Zielvorgaben

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit

  • Spannende Einblicke in die Automobilbranche, Elektromobilität, Werkstatt, Fahrzeughandel sowie Carrosserie und Lackiererei

  • Ein motiviertes, hilfsbereites Team mit spannenden Persönlichkeiten und Geschichten

  • Die Möglichkeit unseren digitalen Markenauftritt aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Ein modernes und vielseitiges Arbeitsumfeld

  • Attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile rund ums Automobil

  • 5 Wochen Ferien

  • Kostenloser Mitarbeiterparkplatz

Bereit, unsere Geschichten zu erzählen?

Bei uns erwartet dich kein klassischer Bürojob. Du bist mittendrin, wenn Fahrzeuge repariert, lackiert, verkauft oder spannende technische Herausforderungen gelöst werden.

Du lernst unsere Mitarbeitenden kennen, entdeckst interessante Geschichten und machst daraus Inhalte, die Menschen begeistern und unser Unternehmen bekannter machen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht auf den nächsten Auftrag wartet, sondern selbst Ideen entwickelt, mitdenkt und gerne Verantwortung übernimmt.

Du fühlst dich angesprochen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Überzeuge uns mit deiner Kreativität, deiner Persönlichkeit und deiner Motivation. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen und mehr über deine Ideen zu erfahren.

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams bei der Hüsser & Palkoska AG.

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to land and expand n8n inside the world’s largest organisations, closing the biggest deals in our portfolio.

As a Large Enterprise Account Executive covering Nordics & Benelux, you will own a territory of global-scale accounts and lead long, complex deals from first conversation to multi-year commitment:

BUILD STRATEGIC ACCOUNT PLANS

  • Build and execute account strategies for organisations with 5,001 or more employees

  • Open doors with outbound campaigns aimed at CTOs, CIOs and engineering and platform leaders.

  • Turn community adoption inside large companies into sponsored, funded opportunities.

LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-THREADED DEALS

  • Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build an executive-level business case.

  • Map and align decision makers across engineering, IT, security, legal and procurement.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships and Customer Success to prove value and de-risk adoption.

CLOSE AND EXPAND AT SCALE

  • Own the cycle through security, legal and procurement, typically over three to six months or more.

  • Negotiate six-figure deals with confidence and keep clear commercial control.

  • Plan expansion across business units and use cases, and share what you learn with Product and leadership.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏢 Large Enterprise sales: You have at least five years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, selling into organisations with 5,001 or more employees, and you can explain customer size, deal complexity and cycle length.

  • 💰 Six-figure deals: You have closed multiple deals of £100k+ ACV in multi-stakeholder cycles of three to six months or more.

  • 🧑‍💻 Technical buyers and executives: You have sold to developers, engineers, CTOs and CIOs, and you can carry a technical conversation and an executive one in the same deal.

  • 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past two to three years.

  • 📍 Location: You are based in the Nordics / Benelux. This role involves regular travel to customers in the region.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical product background: You have sold developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data, AI or automation platforms.

  • 🤝 Partner-led deals: You have worked deals with system integrators or cloud partners.

  • 🚀 Open source or PLG exposure: You understand how community adoption turns into enterprise revenue.

Why join us?

You will close the largest deals in our portfolio and shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest organisations, with a product technical teams already use and love. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships, Customer Success and Product, and leadership will listen to what you learn in the field. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the global enterprise.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).
