title: Marketing and Commercial Specialist (Canada)
description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good.

With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

You’ll be the operational co-pilot for our Canadian team as we build Who Gives A Crap into a household brand in Canada. Day to day, that means keeping campaigns moving, keeping commercial pipelines organised and making sure the day-to-day runs smoothly. It isn’t just about updating trackers. It’s about the groundwork that makes sure our brand lands locally and our regional commercial milestones get hit.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Coordinating campaign delivery across social, influencer, PR and events, so cross-functional work lands on schedule
  • Flagging project blockers early and keeping shared timelines and status documentation up to date
  • Being the day-to-day point of contact for our local agencies
  • Coordinating the Canadian social calendar with our global creative team and local agencies
  • Reviewing global and local content to make sure it feels authentically Canadian and on brand
  • Reviewing agency pitches for influencers and giving constructive feedback before they go to the Director for sign-off
  • Keeping the Canadian marketing budget tracker accurate, with zero errors
  • Working through inbound Canadian B2B enquiries, from bulk requests to reorders

Let’s talk about you

You’re a details person who loves a fast-moving team

We’re launching a new market, which means the work moves quickly and the to-do list changes often. You like having lots of moving parts in play and keeping them tidy. You know when to chase a deadline, when to flag a blocker early and when to ask for help.

You have a sharp instinct for what feels right

You notice when copy, an asset or an agency pitch sounds off brand or out of touch with Canadian nuances, and you can say why. You’re keen to suggest local ideas worth testing.

You like to follow the numbers

You’re comfortable in a dashboard. You enjoy spotting what’s working, what isn’t and what to test next, and you’d rather turn a messy report into a clear next step than wait for someone else to do it.

You give a crap

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

As the global leader in the technical interview space (3,800+ customers in 165+ countries), it is our Strategic Account Executive’s goal to identify technical hiring challenges and drive the CoderPad value proposition for a book of target accounts.

You’ll report to our Sales Manager and own the sales process from start to finish while also regularly engaging on customer calls.

What you'll be doing:

  • Outbound prospecting (call, email, LinkedIn, etc.) into a triaged list of target accounts and engaging Talent Acquisition/HR and Engineering stakeholders with CoderPad’s value proposition

  • Participate on key client calls with your Customer Success teammates, including quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and renewal discussions

  • Establish a trusted advisor/consultant approach with new prospects and existing customers

  • Suggest new ideas to improve our product, process, and workflows based on customer feedback and strategic approaches

  • Achieve pre-defined outbound activity, pipeline, and revenue targets

  • Engage with a value-based selling approach to delight our customers!

What you should bring:

  • 3 years+ in SaaS sales positions, with at least 2 years as an Account Manager or Account Executive at a B2B tech company

  • Experience focused on expansion opportunities is preferred

  • A hunter mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and ability to collaborate with internal stakeholders from Marketing, Product, and especially Customer Success to drive a premium customer experience

  • Ability to operate with ambiguity, test and define new ideas, and engage executive buyers with innovative approaches and solutions. One of our values is being bold and this role requires that.

  • A team-player who brings positivity and energy to the team, as well as a strong customer support lens to the account relationships

  • Proficiency in a sales process

  • AI Fluency (and excitement!)

Compensation

Compensation for this role includes: 50/50 base salary and variable + accelerators

Base salary range (in USD): $75,000 - $85,000 with OTE for this role: $145,000 - $165,000

Exact salary is based on skills, experience, location, market ranges, and other compensation offered. The salary range does not include equity and company-wide benefits you may be eligible to receive.

Additional Information

Benefits for You

We are a geographically distributed company. We entrust every team member – personally and professionally. If you enjoy working with a diverse group that truly values team collaboration, we are interested in hearing from you.

While these benefits are specific for full-time US-based employees, qualified candidates from other countries may be considered at CoderPad. All of the benefits below may not apply depending on an employee's country of residence and employment type, though appropriate compensation and benefits will still be offered.

• Medical coverage from day one: CoderPad pays 85-90% of employee premiums (90% on the HDHP plan), plus up to $9,000 in HRA funding on the HDHP plan
• Dental and vision: 100% covered for you, up to 80% for dependents
• Company-funded life, short-term and long-term disability coverage
• 401K with profit sharing. You get the company contribution even if you don't contribute yourself
• Unlimited PTO (we expect at least 3 weeks a year) plus 20 company holidays
• Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (primary) or 12 weeks (secondary) with full pay, benefits and equity vesting
• Remote-first, with a $300 monthly stipend for home office and work expenses
• Wellness perks: Headspace, One Medical and more through Cigna
• Stock options (4-year vesting), competitive salary and growth opportunities

And more…

CoderPad is committed to hiring the best talent. To work at CoderPad, employees must have the permanent and unrestricted right to work in their country of residence without needing present or future sponsorship from the company. If you meet this requirement, all applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, or veteran or disability status. Our goal is to be a diverse team that represents a variety of backgrounds and perspectives and a culture where everyone feels included.

Research has shown that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply for a role if they do not meet 100% of the qualifications. Please know that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel you only are a 75% match. We promote a diverse and inclusive culture at CoderPad.

title: Mid-Enterprise Account Executive, Sao Paolo
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

The Mid-Enterprise Account Executive is a key role responsible for driving sales growth and expanding the customer base in the cybersecurity technology sector. The focus is on acquiring new accounts, building strong customer relationships, and ensuring customer satisfaction and retention. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in selling cybersecurity technologies, introducing disruptive cyber software solutions, and exceeding sales quotas consistently. They will also be adept at establishing and nurturing Channel Partner relationships, with pre-existing connections with key resellers in the region being a crucial requirement.

  • Sales Experience: Minimum of 3-5 years of successful sales experience in the cybersecurity technology industry, with a strong track record of achieving sales growth

  • Introduction of New Solutions: Demonstrated success in introducing and selling new disruptive cyber software solutions

  • Quota Achievement: Proven ability to exceed sales quotas consistently quarter over quarter.

  • Channel Partner Management: Experience in establishing and monetizing strong Channel Partner relationships, with existing relationships in the region being essential.

  • Sales Process Management: Proficiency in managing all aspects of the sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, and deal closure.

  • Post-Sales Management: Ability to manage and drive the post-proof of value ROI process.

  • CRM and Pipeline Management: Experience in accurately tracking and managing customer information in company-provided CRM, and maintaining an accurate pipeline and forecasting in Salesforce (SFDC).

  • Product Presentation and Demo: Capability to present and demonstrate Horizon3AI solutions effectively in both virtual and in-person meetings.

  • Independent and Team Player: Demonstrated ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with distributed sales, support, and success teams.

  • Sales Methodology: Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling type sales methodologies.

  • Sales and Marketing Tools: Familiarity with sales enablement tools like Salesforce, CRM, Outreach.io, Linked-In Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and Slack.

What You’ll Bring

  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience working in the INFOSEC or SaaS space

  • Must be located in Sao Paolo, Brazil

Travel Required

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 20% of travel within assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

We're expanding our sales team in the UK & Ireland area and seeking motivated and successful Account Executives at the Mid-Market level to join us! This role offers a unique opportunity to take your sales career to the next level, with potential for upward mobility.

As an Account Executive, you’ll represent Customer.io to prospective customers and drive growth within key market segments. This is a full-cycle sales role (prospect, demo, close), where you'll be fielding both inbound and outbound demand.

About Customer.io

Over 10,000 companies from scrappy startups to global brands use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

Responsibilities:

  • Pipeline Development and Management: Build and manage a pipeline through self-sourced leads and SDR-supported leads, alongside inbound opportunities, to drive new customer acquisition.
  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Lead the entire sales process from prospecting and discovery through demo and closing, focusing on new business acquisition within targeted accounts.
  • Customer Needs Analysis and Solution Alignment: Conduct discovery calls to understand customer business challenges and goals. Position Customer.io's solutions to meet these needs effectively and connect them to clear customer business outcomes.
  • Collaboration and Cross-Functional Feedback: Work closely with the SDR and BDR teams for lead quality feedback and collaborate with Customer Success and Technical Support for a smooth hand-off post-sale.
  • Performance Tracking and Reporting: Own and report on individual sales metrics, including pipeline status and progress towards targets, to support informed decision-making.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B SaaS or MarTech sales, handling mid-market accounts
  • Location: We are currently hiring for positions based in the United Kingdom or Ireland only.
  • B2B SaaS or MarTech Experience: Proven success in new customer acquisition and closing deals within the B2B SaaS space, preferably MarTech, including generating pipeline through outbound prospecting.
  • Sales Methodology: Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar framework that supports consultative selling and discovery to close.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and engaging presence to build rapport with new prospects.
  • Problem Solving: Strong ability to identify customer business needs and position relevant solutions effectively to drive acquisition and customer business impact.
  • Deal Focus: Primarily handles mid-market accounts up to 500 employees
  • Support: Works closely with our SDR and BDR teams for lead generation, with a balance between inbound, BDR sourced and self-sourced opportunities
  • Responsibilities:
    • Engage in high-volume prospecting, cold and warm outreach
    • Manage the full sales cycle for deals typically under $20,000-75,000 ACV
    • Drive growth within mid-sized clients, nurturing relationships and uncovering business needs

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. We are offering a compensation package of $95,000 base + $95,000 variable for a total $190,000 OTE USD (or equivalent in local currency), subject to market rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

  1. 30-minute video call with Recruiter
  2. 45-minute video call with Manager
  3. 30-minute video call with Bar Raiser

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We are passionate about our core values of Empathy, Transparency, Responsibility, and Awkwardness and are looking for new coworkers to share and build that passion!

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Description

Electrical Engineer Subject Matter Expert (SME) - Critical Facilities

WORK LOCATION: REMOTE (WITH OCCASIONAL TRAVEL)

This is a remote position with travel required for project site visits during the Construction Administration (CA) phase and site surveys for existing facilities (brownfield projects). All approved business travel expenses are reimbursed in accordance with company travel policies.

Candidates who prefer an office-based or hybrid work arrangement may discuss available options.

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: 10%–25%

SALARY RANGE: $120,000–$170,000 annually

Job Summary:

Seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer with 5-10 years of experience designing and leading mission critical electrical infrastructure projects. Serves as the technical authority for power distribution, utility integration, standby generation, UPS systems, grounding, and overall electrical system resiliency. Responsible for developing reliable, maintainable, and scalable electrical solutions while supporting project delivery, mentoring engineering staff, and serving as a trusted advisor to clients and project teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead electrical SME for mission critical and data center projects.
  • Develop electrical system architectures supporting N, N+1, 2N, and concurrently maintainable design strategies.
  • Lead electrical design through planning, concept development, schematic design, design development, construction documents, commissioning, and construction administration phases.
  • Perform and oversee electrical load analysis, equipment sizing, fault current calculations, arc flash assessments, and protective device coordination studies.
  • Lead utility coordination efforts including service applications, capacity assessments, and interconnection requirements.
  • Provide technical oversight for medium-voltage and low-voltage distribution systems.
  • Develop power system concepts including utility substations, generators, UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, automatic transfer switches, and power monitoring systems.
  • Coordinate with mechanical, controls, telecommunications, structural, architectural, and civil disciplines.
  • Support commissioning planning, integrated systems testing (IST), and operational readiness activities.
  • Lead technical design reviews and quality assurance/quality control processes.
  • Mentor junior electrical engineers and provide technical guidance across project teams.

Preferred Experience

  • 5-10 years of electrical engineering experience with a focus on mission critical, data center, industrial, or healthcare facilities.
  • Experience with hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and edge data center environments.
  • Familiarity with utility-scale infrastructure and campus-wide electrical distribution systems.
  • Experience with power systems supporting facilities ranging from 3 MW to 100+ MW campuses.

description:
We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm

Hello! We are GoFasti, a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe.

We need an English-fluent Scheduler, based in Latin America, available to work remotely.

We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills.

Are you the one we are looking for?

Responsibilities:

  • Create, assign, and manage all client visits in WellSky, including Start of Care (SOC), Recertification, Resumption of Care (ROC), Follow-Up, and Routine visits.

  • Build and maintain accurate visit schedules for skilled nursing (RN/LPN), therapy (PT, OT, SLP), and aide staff.

  • Enter and update visit authorizations based on payer source, including Medicare, Medicaid, private pay, and managed care plans.

  • Process physician orders tied to visit frequency and duration within WellSky.

  • Monitor the scheduling dashboard daily for unscheduled, missed, or conflicting visits.

  • Coordinate with the clinical team to ensure visit frequency aligns with the Plan of Care (485).

  • Match field clinicians and aides to clients based on availability, geographic location, skill set, and payer requirements.

  • Maintain staff availability calendars, including PTO, call-outs, and schedule changes.

  • Communicate schedule changes to clinicians, aides, and supervisors in a prompt and professional manner.

  • Identify and fill coverage gaps to prevent missed visits and care disruptions.

  • Maintain accurate employee profiles in WellSky, including credentials and authorized service types.

  • Verify and track visit authorizations for all payers prior to scheduling any visit.

  • Alert the billing and intake teams of authorization changes, expirations, or denials in a timely manner.

  • Ensure all visits are scheduled within authorized units, service codes, and effective dates.

  • Flag potential compliance issues including overlapping visits, duplicate billing risks, or frequency discrepancies.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for scheduling inquiries from clinicians, clients, and family members.

  • Communicate daily with the clinical supervisor regarding visit coverage, staffing needs, and patient care priorities.

  • Escalate urgent or clinical concerns to the appropriate supervisor immediately and without delay.

  • Participate in daily or weekly scheduling huddles and interdisciplinary team meetings as required.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date visit records in WellSky at all times.

  • Run and review scheduling reports — including missed visits, visit utilization, and authorization utilization — and distribute findings to supervisors.

  • Support the billing team by ensuring visit documentation is complete, accurate, and submitted in a timely manner.

  • Assist with internal audits, external reviews, and compliance activities as needed.

Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED required.

  • Associate's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

  • 1+ years of experience as a Scheduler.

  • 1 - 2 years of scheduling experience in a home health, hospice, or healthcare setting preferred.

  • Prior experience with WellSky (formerly Kinnser) strongly preferred.

  • Experience with managed care authorization processes preferred.

  • Proficient in the WellSky EMR and scheduling platform.

  • Strong organizational skills with the demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills across clinical and administrative settings.

  • Ability to problem-solve quickly and adapt effectively to rapidly changing schedules and priorities.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and record maintenance.

  • Familiarity with home health regulations, payer requirements, and visit compliance standards.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

It's a plus:

  • Associate's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Prior experience with WellSky (formerly Kinnser).

  • Experience with managed care authorization processes.

Compensation:

  • The salary range offered for this position varies from (USD) $1,000 - $1,500 per month, depending on seniority and skillset.

  • This is a 40 hours per week.

  • This position is for a full time contract, through a payroll platform.

Application review/approval > Screening interview with GoFasti's team > We build and send your profile to our client > Profile review/approval by client > Interview with the client > Hiring and onboarding.

The Opportunity:
CACI is seeking an experienced SailPoint IAM Engineer to join a dynamic, high-performing team responsible for operating and maintaining the Identity IQ platform for a government customer. In this role, the Identity and Access Management (IAM) engineer will provide technical guidance to the program manager and key stakeholders, specifically focusing on enterprise-scale projects and solutions. The IAM Engineer will play a critical role in implementing solutions designed by the IAM architect, ensuring that these solutions meet organizational needs and standards.


Responsibilities:
As a key member of the team delivering next-generation IAM services, the engineer will assist in defining, developing, and implementing IAM solutions that reduce risk and enhance resiliency, while also supporting the acceleration of important business initiatives. Collaboration will be essential; the engineer will work closely with professionals in Microsoft Azure, network, and security architecture to ensure seamless integration and operation of IAM services. Additionally, the engineer will coordinate with vendors to evaluate, test, and deploy new technology solutions as needed.

Implement IAM solutions to support PIV/Certificate Base Authentication, FIDO
• Engineer and maintain a secure and robust enterprise access management solution
• Facilitate and support IAM integration into business applications and third parties, including Single Sign On enablement using modern protocols (SAML, OAuth, Open ID Connect)
• Collaborate with customers to define organization constructs/naming conventions and user access roles
• Assist with the development of process and workflows to support IAM operation activities such as user onboarding, user lifecycle management and privilege access management
• Provide assistance with the integration of an Enterprise PKI solution.
• Engage with, and advise stakeholders within the business on Identity and Access Management best practices
• Define, improve, and support Azure Entra ID and Privileged Access Management within the organization
• Identify areas for delivery of automated solutions (e.g. onboarding/offboarding) and maturation of existing processes by leveraging scripting



Qualifications:

Required:
Ability to obtain Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Entry On Duty (EOD) - Active EOD preferred
• BA/BS + 8 years of applicable experience; AA + 10 years’ applicable experience
• Experience in the Identity space with a background in identity management tools
• Strong knowledge of HSPD12 and implementation of government smart card authentication
• Expert knowledge of authentication with SAML, OAuth, OpenID, WSO2, and Kerberos
• Prior experience in providing RBAC solutions for clouds solutions (e.g. Azure)
• Strong scripting and automation abilities including PowerShell
• Understanding of Microsoft Azure PIM, Access Reviews, Service Principles, Managed Identities and ABAC
• Strong knowledge of enterprise PKI integration with SCEP and ACME clients
• Experience in creating technical architecture documentation
• Strong communication and written skills.


Desired:

ITILv3 or v4 Foundation’s certification

• Previous DHS or DoD experience

  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
    • CompTIA A+, or Network+, or Security+
    • Experience with Azure Cloud, scripting, and automation
-

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. $98,500-$206,800

description:
About Tester Work

Tester Work is a global QA crowdsourcing platform that connects companies building digital products with a community of freelance testers worldwide. We help businesses improve their websites, mobile apps, and software by enabling real users to test products in real-world conditions and provide structured feedback.

As a tester, you’ll get access to flexible, project-based opportunities where you can earn money by executing test cases, exploring applications, and sharing usability feedback that helps improve digital products.

 

Overview

We are currently looking for QA testers to join our testing community. Once onboarded, you will gain access to our latest project and you'll be able to help us fine-tune a personal AI assistant developed by one of the biggest tech companies on the market. Besides, a variety of projects across different industries, including e-commerce, fintech, entertainment, and mobile applications, will also be available for you.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Follow step-by-step test cases to validate user flows (e.g., sign-up, login, checkout, payments)
  • Explore apps and websites to identify bugs or usability issues
  • Submit clear bug reports with steps, screenshots, or recordings when needed
  • Test region-specific features and localized functionality when required

 

Who This Role Is For

Based in one of the following countries:

  1. Switzerland (French and German speakers)
  2. Sweden (Native Swedish speakers)
  3. Luxembourg (English speakers)
  4. Belgium (Dutch and French speakers)
  5. Denmark (Native Danish speakers)
  6. Norway (Native Norwegian speakers)
  7. Finland (Native Finnish speakers)
  8. Saudi Arabia (Native Arabic speakers)
  9. Israel (Native Hebrew speakers)
  • Comfortable using websites, mobile apps and AI
  • QA/testing experience is a plus, but not required

 

What You Can Expect

  • Fully remote, flexible, project-based work
  • No fixed schedule, choose tasks based on your availability
  • Exposure to a wide range of digital products and industries
  • Opportunity to build QA/testing experience over time
  • Ongoing access to new testing cycles once onboarded

 

Compensation

  • Payment varies depending on project scope and complexity
  • Each assignment clearly defines tasks and compensation upfront
  • All payments are processed securely via PayPal, Wise or Upwork 

 

If you enjoy exploring apps, identifying issues, and helping improve digital products, this is a great opportunity to gain experience and earn flexible income as part of a global testing community.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

Location: Fully Remote (US)

About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

title: Copywriter
description:
As a Copywriter (m/w/d), you will own the words behind PERGOLUX campaigns across our global markets, writing and editing copy for Meta, Google, email, and web that turns product benefits into clear, persuasive messaging. You will shape headlines, product descriptions, campaign concepts, and calls to action, adapting tone and messaging for different audiences, languages, and cultural contexts while keeping brand voice consistent. Working closely with marketing, product, e-commerce, and sales colleagues, you will drive copy quality from first draft through hands-on editing and testing.

PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations spanning 8 markets.

What You'll Do

- Write and edit copy for Meta, Google, email, web, and other marketing channels, developing compelling headlines, product descriptions, and calls to action.

- Optimise copy for Meta and Google campaigns, testing different messaging angles and calls to action to improve campaign performance.

- Support the product page redesign process with clear, conversion-focused copy that communicates key benefits and improves the user experience.

- Adapt messaging across multiple markets, languages, and cultural nuances while keeping brand voice and tone consistent through hands-on quality checks.

- Collaborate with global and local teams across marketing, product, e-commerce, and sales to deliver effective, on-brand communication.

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years of copywriting experience with a strong portfolio of high-quality work for digital marketing channels, including paid ads, email, web, and social media.

- Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills in English, with a strong eye for detail, accuracy, and consistency.

- A solid grasp of brand voice, storytelling, and persuasive messaging, plus copywriting best practices like SEO, readability, and conversion-focused writing.

- The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment, staying organised and process-oriented.

- Nice to have: experience with AI writing tools and localisation workflows, familiarity with Jira, Figma, and Canva, and knowledge of a European language beyond English or German (e.g. Swedish, French, Italian).

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, no endless unpaid crunch

🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take real ownership of your work from the start with direct impact on campaign and business outcomes, work alongside an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior roles as PERGOLUX scales.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in the EU/UK

🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle

- Team culture with regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats

- Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows)

- Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products

- Jobrad / Bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting

📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin

How to Apply

Ready to shape the words behind our campaigns? Apply through our [Career Page](https://pergolux.careers/) or connect with us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/pergolux/posts/?feedView=all).

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Data, Controlling & KPI-Reporting
description:
Einarbeitung (Monat 1–2): Du lernst unsere Datenquellen, KPIs und bestehenden Auswertungen kennen und erstellst die Reports zunächst gemeinsam mit unserem Team, dann zunehmend selbstständig.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Tägliches KPI-Reporting: Du stellst dem Head of KAM jeden Tag alle benötigten Auswertungen bereit: aktuell, korrekt und auf den Punkt.

  • Kennzahlen im Blick: Du verfolgst die wichtigsten KPIs und vergleichst sie mit den Vorwochen und dem Durchschnitt.

  • Proaktive Abweichungsanalyse: Weichen Zahlen ab, meldest Du das von Dir aus und ordnest ein, was dahintersteckt.

  • Ursachen finden, Handlungsbedarf erkennen: Du analysierst die Gründe und zeigst auf, bei welchen Teammitgliedern Unterstützung oder Handlungsbedarf besteht.

  • Reports weiterentwickeln & automatisieren: Du optimierst bestehende Auswertungen und automatisierst wiederkehrende Reports, wo es sinnvoll ist.

  • Ad-hoc-Analysen: Du übernimmst kurzfristige Analysen für das Key Account Management.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist eingeschriebener Student, z. B. in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsmathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Fach.

  • Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Zahlen und gehst sicher mit MS Excel oder Google Sheets um.

  • Plus, aber kein Muss: Erste Erfahrung mit SQL, BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Tableau oder im Controlling.

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig und strukturiert, auch wenn es mal schnell gehen muss.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und traust Dich, Auffälligkeiten direkt anzusprechen, auch gegenüber Führungskräften.

  • Du kannst 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten, verteilt auf alle Wochentage (Mo–Fr), da das Reporting täglich anfällt.

  • Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin Mitte.

  • Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch (mindestens C1), da Du täglich Auswertungen mit dem Head of KAM besprichst und Auffälligkeiten klar kommunizierst. C2 ist ein Plus.

Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung – Du hast einen direkten Draht zum Head of Key Account Management, und Deine Analysen zählen jeden Tag.

  • Praxiswissen für Studium und Karriere – Du sammelst Erfahrung in Controlling, KPI-Reporting und Datenanalyse.

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung – Innerhalb des Tages stimmst Du Deine Arbeitszeiten auf Deine Vorlesungen ab. In der Prüfungsphase finden wir gemeinsam eine Lösung.

  • Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte – Zentral gelegen, mit bester Anbindung und freundlicher Atmosphäre.

  • Top Equipment – Laptop, Bildschirm, Headset – alles für Deinen Erfolg.

  • Innovative Tools – Slack, Zoom & CRM-Systeme, die Deinen Arbeitsalltag effizient machen.

  • Events & Teambuilding – Ob Fußball, Volleyball oder After-Work: Bei uns kommt der Spaß nicht zu kurz.

  • Snacks & Drinks – Gratis Kaffee, Getränke, Obst und individuelle REWE-Snacks auf Knopfdruck.

  • FRIYAY-Mood – Jeden Freitag gemeinsamer Ausklang mit Pizza und Bier.

  • Office Dogs welcome – Dein Vierbeiner ist bei uns herzlich willkommen.

Klingt nach Dir? Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinem Lebenslauf. Ein Anschreiben brauchst Du nicht, ein paar Sätze, warum Dich die Stelle reizt, freuen uns aber. Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Pflegia ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin, das auf Eigenverantwortung, transparente Kommunikation und partnerschaftliches Arbeiten setzt. Bei uns zählt nicht, woher Du kommst, sondern wohin Du gemeinsam mit uns willst.

title: Group Financial Accountant
description:
The Group Financial Accountant will provide support in preparing the consolidated Group accounts for publishing (both internal and external) and be a main point of contact for EY, the Group’s external auditors. Additionally, the role will deputise for the Senior Director, Financial Reporting.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Financial Reporting and accounting

    • Maintain the Groups consolidation system (BPC) and perform basic consolidations including generating and posting consolidation journal entries

    • Ensuring accurate and complete exchange rates are maintained in SAP and BPC

    • Supporting colleagues using BPC to generate Group reports e.g. Group cash reporting and tax reporting

    • Account for the Group’s internal and external debt including loan fees

    • Accounting for deferred taxes on Group intangibles and deferred revenues

    • Reporting on Group Fixed assets in reporting currency (USD)

    • Accounting for Group Intangibles including amortisation

    • Support local Controllers with lease accounting entries

    • Maintain the Group’s external Cash Flow model

    • Support the US GAAP reporting team and help maintain the analysis of GAAP bridge adjustments

    • Support the preparation of annual consolidated Group accounts and related audit requests

    • Prepare detailed accounts for Sophos Parent (Jersey) with emphasis on equity movements

    • Prepare intermediate holding company annual report and accounts

    • Prepare external reports as requested by the owners e.g. Hart-Scott-Rodino

    Share-based payments

    • Maintain / update valuations of equity awards on the Groups Equity platform for the purposes of expense valuation reporting

    • Support Local entity controllers with annual disclosures

    • Generate detailed movement tables for disclosure notes

     

    Ad hoc

    • Provide accounting support and / or oversight for internal restructurings

    • Assist in the accounting for major transactions e.g. acquisitions / debt refinancing

    • Support management queries / report requests

    • Investigate large / unusual account movements

Experience

  • Essential

    • Good grasp of basic accounting entries (debits and credits)

    • Large company ERP system exposure, SAP preferred

    • Understanding of basic consolidations

    Desirable

    • Working within a global organisation, ideally a software company

    • IFRS and US GAAP accounting standards

    • Accounting for the impact of foreign exchange rates

Skills & Abilities

  • Essential

    • Excellent communication skills at all levels

    • The ability to work to deadlines whilst maintaining accuracy and attention to detail

    • Good MS Office skills, particularly Excel to intermediate level (pivot tables and Lookups)

    Desirable

    • Presentation skills

    • Experience using AI tools, particularly the Microsoft suite of products

    • Exposure to foreign currency impact and consolidations

Qualifications

  • Essential

    • Newly qualified ACA / ACCA

    Desirable

    • Treasury

Training

  • Essential

    • Training and mentoring will be provided as part of the position, with the aim of being able to deputise for the Senior Director, Financial Reporting

    Desirable

    • An ambition to continue studying and developing skills in relation to consolidations / large transactions / Treasury

title: Sales Development Representative (Inbound)
description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, & designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, & AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, & Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, & a fast-growing global community.

About The Role

Most of Kestra's pipeline starts with someone who already found us: a demo request, a Kestra Cloud trial, a webinar sign-up, or an engineer from the open-source community who wants to talk to Sales. We sell Kestra Enterprise, self-hosted in the customer's own infrastructure, & Kestra Cloud, our fully managed edition.

We're looking for our first inbound Sales Development Representative in Europe to turn that interest into qualified pipeline. You follow up on every inbound lead, qualify it honestly against our Ideal Customer Profile, & pass it to the right Account Executive.

You work closely with our Lead Growth Engineering team, who build & run the systems that capture, score, & route our inbound demand. Together you decide which signals matter, tighten routing, & make sure no good lead goes cold. You report to the Head of Sales & hand off daily to our European Account Executives.

Your buyers are technical: data engineers, platform engineers, & the leaders who run those teams. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be curious enough to learn the product & talk credibly about orchestration.

What You'll Own

Follow-up

  • Every inbound lead routed to you: demo & contact requests, Kestra Cloud trials & sign-ups, event & webinar follow-ups, & community hand-raises.

  • Speed to lead: a first personal reply within 1 business hour, & at least 4 follow-up attempts over 7 business days before closing a lead out.

  • Messages that read like a person wrote them: short, relevant, & clearly based on what the prospect actually asked for.

Qualification

  • Qualification calls that uncover the prospect's use case, current tooling (Airflow, cron, homegrown scripts, cloud-native schedulers), team, & timeline.

  • Honest qualification against our Ideal Customer Profile: a real business pain Kestra solves, & someone involved in evaluating or buying.

  • Clean disqualification: leads that don't fit go back to nurture with a clear reason, so the team learns which sources bring good demand.

Hand-off to Account Executives

  • Routing each qualified lead to the right Account Executive by territory & segment, or to the account owner when there is already an open opportunity or an existing customer.

  • First meetings that actually happen, with a written brief so the prospect never has to repeat themselves.

  • Accurate records in HubSpot: every lead, call, & disqualification reason logged, so forecasts & routing can be trusted.

Partnership with Lead Growth Engineering

  • Feedback on lead quality by source, campaign, & persona, so scoring & routing keep improving.

  • Shaping the inbound playbook: qualification questions, templates, objection handling, & the hand-off checklist.

  • Spotting gaps early: leads routed to the wrong place, signals the system misses, or steps that slow a prospect down.

What We're Looking For

  • 1+ year as an SDR, BDR, or in a similar customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or software company.

  • Inbound experience: you have worked a lead queue against response-time targets & know how to qualify without losing a good prospect.

  • Curiosity about technical products: you enjoy learning how software works & can hold a credible conversation with an engineer.

  • Clear, concise writing: your emails get answered.

  • CRM discipline: you keep records accurate because you know other people rely on them.

  • Fluent in English; a second European language (especially French or German) is a plus.

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote team, with working hours that cover European business hours.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, & equity

  • Medical, dental, & vision insurance

  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance

  • Fully remote, with home-office & equipment budget

  • Learning & conference budget

  • Paid time off, company holidays, & parental leave

Location

Europe

title: Account Executive, France
description:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Senior Account Executive (AE) to play a pivotal role in the growth and expansion of our business. You will be tasked with proactive outbound prospecting and managing inbound leads. Given the technical nature of our product, a high technical aptitude is crucial to understand and articulate the value proposition effectively to potential clients. You will be responsible for the entire sales cycle, including the initial prospecting, qualification, technical discussions, pricing and contract negotiation, deal closure, and expansion. This role demands a combination of technical understanding, sales acumen, and relationship-building skills to drive significant impact and contribute to the company's success.

 

In this role, you will:

 

  • Proactively build, qualify, and close a new logo sales pipeline, ensuring you meet or exceed quota and drive steady bookings growth.

  • Be responsible for outbound motions to create pipeline.

  • Strategically prospect into Network Engineering management & technical end users, understanding their unique challenges and requirements.

  • Build strong and effective relationships with prospects using a consultative sales approach, leading to increased trust and deal velocity.

  • Work on both the acquisition of net new customers and the revenue expansion of existing customer accounts.

  • Work with the Channel team to develop indirect opportunities.

  • Work with the Customer Success team for expansion into existing accounts.

  • Build and manage accurate forecast and opportunity progress reporting.

  • Partner with our Solutions Engineers to ensure technical alignment and convey NetBox Labs’ value proposition and key differentiators.

  • Continually seek to improve your selling skills and iterate/improve on the sales process.

  • Develop an understanding of the partner ecosystem and competitive solutions.

 
 

Requirements:

 

  • 5+ years of SaaS/Networking Equipment field experience with quota-carrying roles in fast-paced markets, focused on closing net new logos and demonstrating the ability to run complex sales processes. Experience working with open source technology is a plus.

  • 1+ years of experience working in a collaborative startup environment.

  • An entrepreneurial and self-starter mentality with the ability to roll up your sleeves and get involved with many aspects of selling to “get it done”

  • A history of overachievement and consistently hitting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Proficiency in managing both inbound leads and outbound prospecting to build a robust pipeline.

  • Drive and competitiveness, underlined by a strong desire to win.

  • Technical aptitude and exceptional ability to articulate the business value of complex, technical enterprise products built on open source technology. Previous experience as a sales engineer or network engineer is a plus.

  • Specialized knowledge in Networking, Network Engineering, Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

title: Security Engineer
description:
At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. That starts with keeping their data safe. As AI makes attackers faster, we’re seeing more critical zero-day vulnerabilities than ever, and we need to stay ahead of them.

That’s where you come in. As our Security Engineer, you’ll own how 700 colleagues get secure access to our systems, and you’ll help defend bunq against attacks as they happen. You’ll design and build security processes that AI can’t run on its own, and automate everything that it can.

Take Ownership 🚀

You’ll keep bunq secure, from access control to incident response. Here’s how you’ll do it:

  • Own access control governance in Okta Identity Governance, automating how access is granted, revoked and reviewed, so every employee and contractor has the right access from day one.

  • Investigate and triage security incidents and vulnerability findings, decide whether they’re malicious, and escalate or fix them fast.

  • Drive the replacement of our security monitoring system with an AI-based platform that detects and stops threats automatically, and build automations so the team can focus on real security issues.


  • You’ve worked hands-on as a security engineer, investigating and triaging security incidents.

  • You write code to automate security work, not just to run scripts.

  • You’ve worked with identity governance and know how to build secure login and access solutions.

  • You communicate clearly with stakeholders, especially under pressure when someone is locked out or an incident hits.

💰 An optional pension plan with monthly contribution from bunq

🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style﻿

Who We Are

We Didn’t Just Rethink PT. We Rebuilt It Around You.

You became a PT to help people—not to sprint through stacked schedules or meet productivity quotas.

That’s why we built Kins: a model that puts you back in control. Here, you treat one patient at a time—for a full hour—so you can deliver the kind of care you were trained to give. You set your schedule. You shape your caseload. And you earn more by focusing on better care, not more visits.

This is physical therapy reimagined—so you can make a real impact, build the career you want, and finally practice on your terms.

In this role

We have a great opportunity to reach more pelvic health patients by offering a virtual only solution to improve access to in-network care for patients. We are looking for physical therapists to treat male pelvic health clients in a remote setting. Virtual pelvic health physical therapy sessions can be conducted from the comfort of your own home or private treatment space.

The perks of being a Kins Physical Therapist

Work when you want:

  • You set your own hours each week (you can include weekends and evenings if you want).

  • No pre-defined shifts — work when you want and for as long as you want!

Competitive pay:

  • We offer highly competitive pay.

  • Get paid per visit — not per unit.

More 1:1 time with highly motivated patients:

  • Our unique model lets you see one patient at a time versus juggling many in a clinical environment.

  • Kins prioritizes convenience with at-home therapy, delivered virtually.

  • Work with a highly motivated patient population that's looking for an individualized physical therapy experience.

  • Provide evidence based, high quality care and guide patients to self-management and successful graduation from care in a value based model

  • Document all treatments and clinical outcome measures in our EMR to routinely assess progress

  • Create a world-class patient experience, communicating via chat and phone with patients and/or providers as needed

  • Able to commit to a minimum of 4 visits/week in a telehealth setting

  • Pelvic Health Level 1 certification with a minimum of 1 year of experience

  • Completed state-regulated CEU requirement in Virginia

  • Commit to a minimum of 4 visits/week

  • Demonstrated excellent written & verbal communication skills

  • Excited to build and deliver a new model for achieving better clinical outcomes

  • Creative and flexible, but always puts the patient first

  • Excellent at forging successful and respectful relationships with the entire team

Pay: Earn $45 per visit

title: Cash Application Analyst | Finance
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need?

We are looking for a cash application Analyst to apply cash to inbound and outbound transactions. You will work closely with the AP/AR teams to ensure all transitions are reconciled and accurate.

This role sit with the Accounting Operations and report to the Senior Accounting Operations Supervisor

In this role you will

  • Work in conjunction with their supervisor and other team members to monitor all transactions in NetSuite for all brands.
  • Review Bank Statements to ensure the system matches the statement
  • Ensure any open tickets are followed up on and closed.
  • Payment Processing: Accurately post high-volume daily deposits (Lockbox, EFT, ACH, and manual remittances) to the correct customer accounts within an ERP system.
  • Account Reconciliation: Match payments to open invoices, clear balances, and reconcile daily deposits to bank records.
  • Journal Entry Posting: Working with the accounting team to post entries that are outside of accounts payable and receivables.
  • Discrepancy Resolution: Research and resolve payment issues such as short payments, double payments, unidentified cash, and unauthorized deductions.
  • Refund Process: Ensure all refunds are processed in a timely manner, and all documentation is accurate and complete
  • Reporting & Compliance: Generate daily, weekly, and monthly reports on cash receipts, unapplied cash, and AR aging. Ensure all processes follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and support SOX or internal audit requests.
  • Communication: Coordinate with customers to obtain missing remittance info and collaborate with internal sales, collections, and credit teams to resolve disputes.
  • Research and compile information as requested.

We are looking for people who have a minimum of 4 years in a AP/AR or cash application position, preferably working in an enterprise level company/corporate finance team.
You will have high numeracy and literacy skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to consult with people at all levels. You will demonstrate the ability to self manage priorities, work in a fast paced environment, and be an excellent collaborator and team player.The Key skills we are looking for:

  • Experience ERP system- preferably Oracle NetSuite
  • Reviewing Banking reports (bank statements, transactions)
  • Researching transitions in the ERP to reconcile inbound and outbound payment
  • Creating Journal entries
  • CRM systems (such as Oracle)
  • Experience working with SOX compliance in a finance environment
  • Working closing with AP/AR
  • Advanced skills in MSOffice and G-suite
  • Working in a global finance setting and have experience in multi currency transactions

You may also have

  • Experience working in a highly acquisitive environment
  • Experience with business transformations and integrations

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

description:

Position Summary

The Product Support Associate serves as the primary point of contact for customers across the Africa region requiring technical assistance with Cepheid products and solutions. As a member of the Tier 1 Technical Support Team, this role provides technical product support to both internal and external customers via telephone, email, web-based platforms, and remote support tools.

The Product Support Associate plays a critical role in delivering an exceptional customer experience by promptly addressing customer inquiries, troubleshooting technical issues, documenting complaints accurately, and ensuring timely escalation of complex cases. The position requires strong customer focus, effective communication skills, and the ability to support diverse customers across multiple African countries. This role aligns with Danaher's commitment to diversity, inclusion, quality, and customer excellence.

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • Customer Support & Technical Assistance
  • Engage customers to understand the nature and urgency of their requests and appropriately triage critical issues.
  • Collect, analyze, and document detailed information related to customer complaints and technical concerns.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting and diagnostics through data collection, product knowledge, and remote access tools.
  • Provide product information, technical guidance, and resolution for routine customer inquiries and complaints.
  • Ensure prompt and professional communication with customers while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

Case Management & Escalation

  • Document customer complaints, investigations, and resolutions accurately within the complaint management system.
  • Ensure all customer interactions and technical findings are recorded in accordance with quality and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify issues requiring advanced technical expertise and prepare complete case documentation for escalation to higher support tiers.
  • Monitor case progress and ensure timely follow-up with customers.

Quality & Compliance


  • Adhere to all Quality Management System (QMS) procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to compliance initiatives through accurate, complete, and concise case documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement activities by identifying recurring issues and recommending corrective actions.
  • Maintain confidentiality of customer information and company data.
  • Maintain current knowledge of Cepheid products, workflows, and support processes.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Technical Support Manager or Supervisor.

Training Responsibilities

  • Complete all mandatory company, product, quality, compliance, and technical training successfully and on time.
  • Maintain proficiency in supported products, systems, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Participate in ongoing learning and professional development initiatives.

Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Biomedical Technology, Medical Laboratory Science, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related field preferred.

OR

  • Diploma or equivalent qualification in a healthcare, medical, scientific, or technical field combined with relevant customer support or laboratory experience.

Experience

  • Experience in customer support, technical support, laboratory diagnostics, healthcare, medical devices, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience supporting customers remotely via phone, email, or web-based platforms is advantageous.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

  • Language Requirements
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency in French and/or Arabic
  • Ability to communicate effectively with customers across diverse cultural and geographical regions.

Technical Skills

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.com or similar CRM systems is advantageous.
  • Ability to learn and support diagnostic instruments, software applications, and laboratory workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

Customer Service Skills

  • Customer-focused with the ability to understand customer expectations and empathize with customer and patient needs.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
  • Demonstrated commitment to delivering outstanding customer service.

Communication Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

Personal Attributes

  • Ability to follow complex processes, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team environment.
  • Adaptable, proactive, and committed to continuous improvement.

Travel Requirements

Limited travel across the Africa region may be required for training, meetings, and customer-related activities.

Why Join Cepheid and Danaher?

At Cepheid, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to technologies that help healthcare professionals make faster, more informed clinical decisions.

As part of Danaher, you will join a global environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, professional development, and diverse perspectives.

We believe in creating an inclusive workplace where associates are empowered to grow, collaborate, and contribute to our shared purpose of improving human health.

At Cepheid, every moment matters. Be part of a team making a meaningful impact on healthcare.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
