description:
PRACTICANTE DE OPERACIONES TÉCNICAS (SOPORTE EN PROPUESTAS Y SISTEMAS PRODUCTIVOS) | EQUIPO LATAM |

REMOTO

Sistema.bio, creando valor del desecho

En Sistema.bio, creemos firmemente que la transición a la energía renovable, la reducción de las emisiones globales de gases de efecto invernadero y la adopción de la agricultura regenerativa son cruciales para garantizar un mundo próspero para las generaciones actuales y futuras.

Fabricamos y distribuimos biodigestores rentables y de alta calidad en América Latina , Asia y África. Nuestros biodigestores permiten a los agricultores convertir residuos en energía renovable y fertilizantes orgánicos, lo que les permite reducir su huella de carbono, aumentar la productividad y operar de manera más eficiente.

Al brindar acceso a tecnología innovadora de biodigestores, Sistema.bio se dedica a abordar los desafíos interconectados de la pobreza, la seguridad alimentaria y el cambio climático.

Tenemos la misión de reducir el 1% de las emisiones globa

les de gases de efecto invernadero 🌱 🌏. ¡Sé parte de esta historia de impacto!

¿Cuál será tu misión en Sistema.bio?

Como Practicante de Operaciones técnicas, darás particular soporte al equipo de la región en la generación de propuestas técnicas y sistemas productivos. Tendrás la oportunidad de conocer la relación entre el diseño técnico de sistemas de biogás, el análisis de información de campo y la implementación de soluciones para productores agrícolas.

A través de proyectos reales y en colaboración con los equipos Comercial y TechOps de LATAM y Global, podrá desarrollar habilidades técnicas, analíticas y de coordinación, al mismo tiempo que contribuye a mejorar nuestros procesos y soluciones.

¿Qué harás como practicante?:

Como parte del equipo de Operaciones Técnicas ubicado en México, estas serán algunas de las áreas en las que estarás colaborando, así como tus principales actividades a desarrollar

Como parte del equipo de Operaciones Técnicas, colaborarás de manera remota con los equipos de México y Global en las siguientes actividades:

  • Elaboración de propuestas técnicas: apoyar en la preparación de diseños y propuestas de sistemas productivos de biogás, utilizando la información del proyecto para identificar soluciones adecuadas a las necesidades de cada productor.
  • Coordinación y seguimiento de proyectos: colaborar con los equipos Comercial y TechOps para recopilar información técnica, dar seguimiento a las solicitudes de propuestas y facilitar la comunicación entre las áreas involucradas.
  • Organización y gestión de información: apoyar en la actualización y documentación de propuestas técnicas, utilizando herramientas como Google Drive y Salesforce para mantener la información organizada y facilitar el seguimiento de cada proyecto.
  • Análisis y mejora continua: participar en la recopilación y análisis de comentarios e incidencias identificadas durante la instalación y operación de sistemas productivos, contribuyendo a detectar oportunidades de mejora.
  • Pruebas y desarrollo de nuevos productos: colaborar en actividades de prueba y validación de nuevas soluciones, apoyando en el seguimiento de su desempeño y en la documentación de los comentarios y aprendizajes obtenidos durante las pruebas de campo.

Esta es una práctica profesional formativa no remunerada, enfocada en el aprendizaje, la mentoría y la experiencia profesional. No implica una relación laboral ni responsabilidades propias de un puesto formal. La duración de la práctica es de 3 a 6 meses, de acuerdo con los requisitos de cada institución educativa para la liberación de prácticas profesionales.

Más sobre tí:

En Sistema.bio buscamos estudiantes con ganas de aprender, crecer y dejar huella, que se entusiasmen por formar parte de un equipo diverso, colaborativo y apasionado por generar impacto positivo en el mundo.

  • Estudiante de una carrera relacionada con ingeniería, sistemas productivos, energías renovables, ingeniería ambiental, ingeniería agrícola o áreas afines.
  • Interés en las energías renovables, el biogás, las soluciones para el sector agrícola y la innovación tecnológica.
  • Capacidad para organizar información, analizar datos y dar seguimiento a distintas actividades.
  • Atención al detalle y disposición para aprender sobre procesos técnicos y comerciales.
  • Habilidades de comunicación y colaboración con equipos de diferentes áreas.
  • Manejo básico de herramientas digitales como Google Drive y hojas de cálculo.
  • Inglés funcional (conversacional - indispensable) para colaborar con integrantes de equipos internacionales, idealmente.

Lo que más valoramos:

title: Remote Vacation Planner
description:
A premier destination in Northwest Florida! Sandestin® Golf and Beach Resort is located on 2,400-acres between the beautiful emerald green waters of the Gulf of Mexico and the shoreline of the Choctawhatchee Bay. Work amongst the most gorgeous backdrops with a company that not only provides a commitment to excellence to guests but also to our people that deliver this experience. Are you the next great addition to the team? Come make memories with us!

General Purpose:

The Remote Golf & Tennis Group Coordinator’s primary responsibility is to capture as many golf and tennis package reservations as possible; by utilizing selling techniques effectively and reaching out to past guests. The ideal candidate would be courteous, self-motivated and detail oriented. A Remote Golf & Tennis Group Coordinator team member must have a primary address within 50 miles of Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort at all times.

Essential Duties:

  • Assist guests by selling golf & tennis package reservations; and create appropriate golf or tennis package based on particular guest needs.
  • Generate & negotiates contracts and agreements with individual group planners.
  • Setup billing to include golf or tennis packages or special billed extras.
  • Work closely with and maintain positive relationship with other employees in golf and tennis departments.
  • Make tee times and necessary preparations for golfers
  • Communicate accurate program/event participant numbers with tennis, book value added tennis clinics & round robins for guests.
  • Promptly follow up with guest inquiry leads for second chance bookings.
  • Answer telephone calls and emails in a clear and professional manner.
  • Maintain potential and current guest profile information.
  • Assist customers with questions regarding their existing reservations.
  • Must have strong ability to multi-task and pay attention to detail.
  • Deliver the highest standard of service to all customers.
  • Effectively manage daily correspondences and operational tasks to exceed customer expectations and expand customer base.
  • Display effective computer literacy and be familiar with MS Office software (Outlook, Word, and Excel).
  • Possess a positive and upbeat attitude at all times.
  • Professional customer service nature with a desire to exceed. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Desire to be part of high growth, fast paced business.

· Other duties as assigned.

Education:

  • One-year certificate from college or technical school; or 12 months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least one year of high-volume call center experience in a metric-driven environment is required. Previous experience with TRACK Pulse and/ or Springer-Miller Systems (SMS) preferred.

Basic Required Skills:

o Must be able to speak, read, write and understand the primary language(s) used in the workplace.

o Must be able to read and write to facilitate the communication process.

o Requires good communication skills, both verbal and written.

o Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, and percentages.

o Must maintain clear and concise documentation and positive approach to conflict resolution.

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to sit for several hours per day.
  • Must be able to bend, stoop, squat, and stretch to fulfill tasks.
  • Must be able to exert a well-paced ability to maneuver between functions occurring simultaneously.
  • Requires grasping, writing, standing, sitting, walking, repetitive motions, bending, climbing, listening and hearing ability, and visual acuity.
  • Talking and hearing occur continuously in the process of communicating with guests, supervisors, and other employees.
  • Vision occurs continuously with the most common visual functions being those of near vision and depth perception.
  • Requires manual dexterity to use and operate all necessary equipment.

title: Remote Customer Service Representative - Independent Contractor
description:
Company Description

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
